################################################################################
# PROJECT: Comparative single-cell analysis of human and chicken erythropoiesis highlights nuclear retention and early avian erythroid immunity
# SCRIPT:  04_Comparative_Nuclear_Fate_Regulation_Human_vs_Avian.R
# 
# PURPOSE: This script establishes a high-resolution human benchmark to compare
#          mammalian enucleation against avian nuclear retention.
#
# DATA SOURCE (Human): 
#   Bandyopadhyay et al. (2024), Cell (DOI: 10.1016/j.cell.2024.04.013).
#   NCBI GEO Accession: GSE253355.
#
# RATIONALE:
#   Utilizes the human bone marrow atlas (HscRNA) from femoral head tissue. 
#   Targeted sub-clustering of MEP, Erythroblast, Late Erythroid, and RBC 
#   clusters captures the full spectrum of human erythropoiesis. This serves 
#   as the basis for identifying divergent markers of enucleation across 
#   the avian and human lineages.
################################################################################


# Load All Required Libraries ---

library(Seurat)
library(monocle3)
library(CellChat)
library(CytoTRACE)
library(scMetabolism)
library(viper)
library(dorothea)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(biomaRt)
library(org.Gg.eg.db)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(plyr)
library(magrittr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(pheatmap)
library(patchwork)
library(cowplot)
library(ggsci)
library(ggvenn)
library(gridExtra)
library(hdf5r)
library(openxlsx)
library(writexl)
library(psych)
library(BiocManager)
library(SeuratWrappers)
library(tidyr)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(glmGamPoi)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(grid)
library(igraph)
library(biomaRt)
library(ggridges)


# Directory Setup ---
# Set working directory to the project root
# setwd("path/to/repository") 
if (!dir.exists("./Results")) dir.create("./Results")
if (!dir.exists("./Processed_Objects")) dir.create("./Processed_Objects")
if (!dir.exists("./Results/Result_Supporting_Files")) {
  dir.create("./Results/Result_Supporting_Files", recursive = TRUE)
}

# ==============================================================================
# SCRIPT 4A: HUMAN BONE MARROW REFERENCE (HscRNA) PROCESSING
# ==============================================================================

#  Load and Subset Human Data
# Requirement: Download GSE253355_Normal_Bone_Marrow_Atlas_Seurat_SB_v2.rds.gz 
# from GEO and place in the Raw_Data folder.
Full_data <- readRDS("./Raw_Data/Public_Reference_Data/Human_Atlas_HscRNA/GSE253355.rds")
# Targeted isolation of the hematopoietic compartment as per manuscript design
selected_clusters <- c("Erythroblast", "Late Erythroid", "MEP", "RBC")
HscRNA_1 <- subset(Full_data, idents = selected_clusters)

# Processing and Dimensionality Reduction
HscRNA_1 <- NormalizeData(HscRNA_1)
HscRNA_1 <- FindVariableFeatures(HscRNA_1, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)
HscRNA_1 <- ScaleData(HscRNA_1)
HscRNA_1 <- RunPCA(HscRNA_1, npcs = 50, verbose = FALSE)
# Plot PC1 vs PC2
pdf(
  file = "./Results/S.Fig_3A.pdf",
  width = 4,
  height = 3
)

DimPlot(
  HscRNA_1,
  reduction = "pca",
  dims = c(1, 2)
)

dev.off()

# Generate an Elbow Plot for selecting PCs
pdf(
  file = "./Results/S.Fig_3B.pdf",
  width = 4,
  height = 3
)

ElbowPlot(
  HscRNA_1,
  ndims = 20
)

dev.off()
# Perform UMAP and clustering
HscRNA_1 <- RunUMAP(HscRNA_1, dims = 1:20)
HscRNA_1 <- FindNeighbors(HscRNA_1, dims = 1:20)
HscRNA_1 <- FindClusters(HscRNA_1, resolution = 0.4)
# Set seed for reproducibility
set.seed(1234)  # Choose any integer value
# Save UMAP plot
pdf(
  file = "./Results/S.Fig_3D.pdf",
  width = 3.5,
  height = 3.5
)

DimPlot(
  HscRNA_1,
  reduction = "umap",
  label = TRUE,
  pt.size = 0.5
) +
  ggtitle("UMAP Clustering")

dev.off()

# Save violin plots for key features
# Calculate cell counts for labels 
# This counts how many cells are in each group within the HscRNA_1 object
n_labels <- table(Idents(HscRNA_1)) 

# Use a wide and short PDF size (10x5) since there are only 2 plots in one row
pdf(file = "./Results/S.Fig_3C.pdf", width = 10, height = 5)

vln_list <- lapply(
  c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA"),
  function(f) {
    # pt.size = 0 removes the dots for a professional look
    p <- VlnPlot(HscRNA_1, features = f, pt.size = 0) + ggtitle(f)
    
    # ADD MEDIAN LINE via boxplot (Satisfies Reviewer 4)
    p <- p + geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, fill = "white", outlier.shape = NA)
    
    # DYNAMIC 'n' LABELS
    # Find the max value for the Y axis to place the text correctly
    gene_data <- FetchData(HscRNA_1, vars = f)
    max_y <- max(gene_data, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    p <- p + 
      scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.2))) + 
      coord_cartesian(clip = "off") + 
      annotate("text", 
               x = 1:length(n_labels), 
               y = max_y, 
               label = n_labels, 
               size = 3, 
               angle = 45, 
               vjust = 0.5, 
               fontface = "bold") +
      theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 10),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 12, face = "bold")
      ) +
      NoLegend()
    
    return(p)
  }
)

# Combine the 2 plots into a single row
p_vln <- cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = vln_list, ncol = 2)
print(p_vln)
dev.off()

# High-Resolution Subsetting
# Subset the dataset based on specific erythroid clusters (5, 1, 2, 8, 6, 0, 4, 9, 10)
selected_clusters <- c(5, 1, 2, 8, 6, 0, 4, 9, 10)
HscRNA <- subset(HscRNA_1, idents = selected_clusters)

# Marker Identification
HscRNA_markers <- FindAllMarkers(
  HscRNA, 
  only.pos = TRUE,     # Only positive markers (upregulated)
  min.pct = 0.25,      # Genes expressed in at least 25% of cells
  logfc.threshold = 0.25 # Log fold change greater than 0.25
)
# Save the top 20 markers to CSV
top20 <- HscRNA_markers %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  top_n(20, wt = avg_log2FC)
write.csv(top20, file = paste0("./Results/Result_Supporting_Files/HscRNA_TOP20.csv"))

# Save the UMAP plot for the selected erythroid clusters
pdf(file = paste0("./Results/Result_Supporting_Files/HscRNA_UMAP_Selected_Clusters.pdf"))
DimPlot(HscRNA, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE, pt.size = 0.5) + 
  ggtitle("UMAP of Selected Clusters") 
dev.off() 

# Final Annotation Preparation
# Reorder cluster identities explicitly to reflect biological maturation
HscRNA <- SetIdent(HscRNA, 
                         value = factor(Idents(HscRNA), levels = c(5, 1, 2, 8, 6, 0, 4, 9, 10)))
# Save the primary human processed object
saveRDS(HscRNA, file = "./Processed_Objects/HscRNA.rds")

# ==============================================================================
# SCRIPT 4B: HUMAN MATURATION PROFILING (CytoTRACE)
# ==============================================================================

# Subset the data to the selected clusters only
HscRNA_red <- HscRNA
# Make sure the clusters are reordered
Idents(HscRNA_red) <- "seurat_clusters"
# Subset HscRNA_red for only the selected maturation clusters
selected_clusters <- c(5, 1, 2, 8, 6, 0, 4, 9, 10)
HscRNA_red <- subset(HscRNA_red, idents = selected_clusters)
# Extract the expression matrix (cells from selected clusters only)
mat <- as.matrix(HscRNA_red@assays$RNA@counts)
# Recreate phe so it matches exactly the cells in subset
phe <- as.character(Idents(HscRNA_red))
names(phe) <- colnames(HscRNA_red)

# Run CytoTRACE Analysis
# Define output directory within Results
# Plot top 10 genes by CytoTRACE score
ct_output <- "./Results/HscRNA_Cytotrace"
if (!dir.exists(ct_output)) dir.create(ct_output, recursive = TRUE)
results <- CytoTRACE(mat = mat)
plotCytoGenes(results, numOfGenes = 10, outputDir = ct_output)
# Plot CytoTRACE for the gene TFRC (One of the most widely used surface markers to stage human erythroid differentiation)
plotCytoTRACE(results, phenotype = phe, gene = "TFRC", outputDir = ct_output)
# Plot CytoTRACE with phenotype labels for your selected clusters
plotCytoTRACE(results, phenotype = phe, outputDir = ct_output)
# Plot CytoTRACE summary plot for your selected clusters
plotCytoTRACE(results, phenotype = phe)

# ==============================================================================
# SCRIPT 4C: CHICKEN-HUMAN ORTHOLOG MAPPING (Ensembl BioMart, release 111)
# ==============================================================================
# PURPOSE:
#   Build a one-to-one chicken-human ortholog table so avian and human erythroid
#   expression can be compared on a shared human gene namespace.
#
# INPUT (manual BioMart export, done once):
#   1. Open https://www.ensembl.org/biomart/martview (use a VPN if it won't load).
#   2. Database: Ensembl Genes | Dataset: Chicken genes.
#   3. Attributes > Gene: Gene stable ID, Gene stable ID version,
#      Transcript stable ID, Transcript stable ID version.
#   4. Attributes > Orthologues > Human: Human gene stable ID, Human gene name,
#      Human homology type, Human orthology confidence.
#   5. Results > Export all results to: File, TSV > Go. Save as:
#      ./External_Data_File/biomart_chicken_human_raw.txt
#
# OUTPUT:
#   orthologs_ALL_ensembl111.tsv      all chicken genes with a human ortholog
#   orthologs_one2one_ensembl111.tsv  one-to-one orthologs only
#
# NOTES:
#   - The raw file is never edited by hand; all filtering is done in code.
#   - Human symbols shared by more than one chicken gene are dropped so the
#     one-to-one table is unique on chicken ID, human ID and human symbol.
# ==============================================================================

library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(Matrix)

# plyr is loaded earlier in this project and masks several dplyr verbs,
# so the dplyr versions are pinned explicitly.
summarise <- dplyr::summarise; mutate <- dplyr::mutate; arrange <- dplyr::arrange
count <- dplyr::count; rename <- dplyr::rename; select <- dplyr::select
filter <- dplyr::filter

if (!dir.exists("./External_Data_File")) dir.create("./External_Data_File")

# --- Input paths ---------------------------------------------------------------
BM_FEATURE_FILES <- c("./Raw_Data/Primary_Avian_Marrow/BM_1/features.tsv.gz",
                      "./Raw_Data/Primary_Avian_Marrow/BM_2/features.tsv.gz")
PB_FEATURE_FILE  <- "./Raw_Data/Public_Reference_Data/Maxwell_2024_PBscRNA/PBscRNA_1/features.tsv"

# --- Helper functions ------------------------------------------------------------

# Read one features file: matrix row name, chicken Ensembl ID, chicken symbol
read_features <- function(f) {
  ft <- read_tsv(f, col_names = FALSE, col_types = cols(.default = "c"))
  data.frame(row = make.unique(ft$X2), chicken_id = ft$X1, chicken_symbol = ft$X2)
}

# Chicken Ensembl ID <-> symbol map (BM_1 and BM_2 must be identical)
build_feature_map <- function() {
  maps <- lapply(BM_FEATURE_FILES, read_features)
  stopifnot(all(sapply(maps[-1], identical, maps[[1]])))
  m <- maps[[1]]
  stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(m$row), !anyDuplicated(m$chicken_id))
  m
}

# Gene symbols present in the peripheral blood reference
pb_symbols <- function() read_tsv(PB_FEATURE_FILE, col_names = FALSE,
                                  col_types = cols(.default = "c"))$X2

load_one2one <- function() read_tsv("./External_Data_File/orthologs_one2one_ensembl111.tsv",
                                    col_types = cols(.default = "c"))

# Map chicken matrix rows to human symbols in two tiers:
#   (1) Ensembl ID via the 1:1 table, (2) name bridge for rows already named
#   with a human symbol. in_PB flags presence in the peripheral blood reference.
chicken_rows_to_human <- function(rows) {
  fm <- build_feature_map()
  o  <- load_one2one() %>% distinct(chicken_id, human_symbol, confidence)
  pb <- pb_symbols()
  a <- fm %>% filter(row %in% rows) %>%
    inner_join(o, by = "chicken_id") %>%
    transmute(row, human_symbol, tier = "ensembl_id", confidence)
  cand <- setdiff(rows, fm$row)
  b <- data.frame(row = cand[cand %in% o$human_symbol], stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(human_symbol = row, tier = "name_bridge") %>%
    left_join(distinct(o, human_symbol, confidence), by = "human_symbol")
  m <- bind_rows(a, b) %>% mutate(in_PB = row %in% pb)
  stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(m$row))
  cat("rows:", length(rows),
      "| by ID:", sum(m$tier == "ensembl_id"),
      "| by name bridge:", sum(m$tier == "name_bridge"),
      "| human symbols:", n_distinct(m$human_symbol),
      "| symbols fed by >1 row:", sum(table(m$human_symbol) > 1), "\n")
  m
}

# Sum counts of rows mapping to the same human symbol; checks total counts
collapse_counts_to_human <- function(cts, m) {
  cts <- as(cts, "CsparseMatrix")
  m   <- m[m$row %in% rownames(cts), ]
  hs  <- unique(m$human_symbol)
  M   <- sparseMatrix(i = match(m$human_symbol, hs), j = match(m$row, rownames(cts)),
                      x = 1, dims = c(length(hs), nrow(cts)),
                      dimnames = list(hs, rownames(cts)))
  out <- M %*% cts
  nz  <- cts; nz@x <- rep(1, length(nz@x))
  overlap <- sum((M %*% nz)@x > 1)
  cat("cells x symbols where >1 merged row is nonzero:", overlap, "\n")
  stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(sum(out), sum(cts[m$row, ]))))
  list(counts = out, map = m, overlap = overlap)
}

# Join per-sample count layers of a Seurat v5 object into one genes x cells matrix
get_chicken_counts <- function(chicken, assay = "RNA") {
  lay   <- grep("^counts", Layers(chicken[[assay]]), value = TRUE)
  mats  <- lapply(lay, function(l) LayerData(chicken, assay = assay, layer = l))
  feats <- Reduce(union, lapply(mats, rownames))
  pad <- function(m) {
    miss <- setdiff(feats, rownames(m))
    if (length(miss)) m <- rbind(m, Matrix::sparseMatrix(
      i = integer(0), j = integer(0), x = numeric(0),
      dims = c(length(miss), ncol(m)), dimnames = list(miss, colnames(m))))
    m[feats, , drop = FALSE]
  }
  cts <- do.call(cbind, lapply(mats, pad))
  stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(colnames(cts)), all(colnames(chicken) %in% colnames(cts)))
  cts[, colnames(chicken), drop = FALSE]
}

# --- Build ortholog tables (run once) --------------------------------------------

raw <- read_tsv("./External_Data_File/biomart_chicken_human_raw.txt",
                col_types = cols(.default = "c"), na = c("", "NA"))
stopifnot(ncol(raw) == 8)
colnames(raw) <- c("chicken_id", "chicken_id_v", "tx_id", "tx_id_v",
                   "human_id", "human_symbol", "orthology_type", "confidence")

# Keep chicken genes that have a human ortholog
full <- raw %>% filter(!is.na(human_id)) %>%
  select(chicken_id, human_id, human_symbol, orthology_type, confidence) %>% distinct()

# Attach chicken symbols from the marrow features file
sym <- build_feature_map() %>% distinct(chicken_id, chicken_symbol)
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(sym$chicken_id))
full <- inner_join(full, sym, by = "chicken_id")

# One-to-one orthologs only; drop human symbols shared by >1 chicken gene
one2one <- full %>% filter(orthology_type == "ortholog_one2one", !is.na(human_symbol))
dup_sym <- one2one$human_symbol[duplicated(one2one$human_symbol)]
cat("Dropping", length(unique(dup_sym)), "human symbols shared by >1 gene\n")
one2one <- one2one %>% filter(!human_symbol %in% dup_sym)

stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(one2one$chicken_id), !anyDuplicated(one2one$human_id),
          !anyDuplicated(one2one$human_symbol))

write_tsv(full,    "./External_Data_File/orthologs_ALL_ensembl111.tsv")
write_tsv(one2one, "./External_Data_File/orthologs_one2one_ensembl111.tsv")
cat("All:", nrow(full), "| 1:1:", nrow(one2one), "\n")


cat("--- Loading and Preparing Human and Avian Data ---\n")

HscRNA <- readRDS("./Processed_Objects/HscRNA.rds")
BMscRNA_PBscRNA <- readRDS("./Processed_Objects/BMscRNA_PBscRNA.rds")

# Rename and subset human erythroid clusters
new_cluster_names_human <- c(
  "0" = "Polychromatic Erythroblast", "1" = "BFU-E", "2" = "CFU-E",
  "4" = "Orthochromatic Erythroblast", "5" = "MEP", "6" = "Basophilic Erythroblast",
  "8" = "Proerythroblast", "9" = "Reticulocyte", "10" = "Mature erythrocyte-H"
)
Idents(HscRNA) <- dplyr::recode(Idents(HscRNA), !!!new_cluster_names_human)

human_order <- c("MEP", "BFU-E", "CFU-E", "Proerythroblast",
                 "Basophilic Erythroblast", "Polychromatic Erythroblast",
                 "Orthochromatic Erythroblast", "Reticulocyte", "Mature erythrocyte-H")
HscRNA <- subset(HscRNA, idents = human_order)

# Rename chicken clusters
new_cluster_names_chicken <- c(
  "0" = "Late polychromatic blast", "1" = "Mid polychromatic blast", "2" = "Late erythroblast",
  "3" = "Erythroid progenitor 2", "4" = "Early polychromatic blast", "5" = "Erythroid progenitor 1",
  "6" = "Immature erythrocyte", "8" = "Early erythroblast", "9" = "Mature erythrocyte-C"
)
Idents(BMscRNA_PBscRNA) <- dplyr::recode(Idents(BMscRNA_PBscRNA), !!!new_cluster_names_chicken)

chicken_order <- c("Erythroid progenitor 1", "Erythroid progenitor 2",
                   "Early erythroblast", "Late erythroblast",
                   "Early polychromatic blast", "Mid polychromatic blast",
                   "Late polychromatic blast", "Immature erythrocyte",
                   "Mature erythrocyte-C")

cat("--- Constructing Ortholog-Matched Profiles ---\n")

# Human: average expression per cluster
human_avg <- AverageExpression(HscRNA, assays = "RNA", layer = "data")$RNA

# Chicken: counts -> human symbols -> CP10K -> collapse -> cluster averages
cts   <- get_chicken_counts(BMscRNA_PBscRNA)
m     <- chicken_rows_to_human(rownames(cts))
cp10k <- cts %*% Matrix::Diagonal(x = 1e4 / Matrix::colSums(cts))  # depth over full transcriptome
dimnames(cp10k) <- dimnames(cts)
res   <- collapse_counts_to_human(cp10k, m)

stage <- as.character(Idents(BMscRNA_PBscRNA))[match(colnames(res$counts), colnames(BMscRNA_PBscRNA))]
chicken_avg <- sapply(split(seq_along(stage), stage),
                      function(i) Matrix::rowMeans(res$counts[, i, drop = FALSE]))

# Genes present in both species and verified in the peripheral blood reference
ok <- m %>% group_by(human_symbol) %>% summarise(ok = any(in_PB)) %>%
  filter(ok) %>% pull(human_symbol)
genes_use <- intersect(intersect(rownames(human_avg), rownames(chicken_avg)), ok)
cat("genes used for correlation:", length(genes_use), "\n")

# Stop if any expected cluster is missing (a rename mismatch would otherwise drop it silently)
stopifnot(all(human_order %in% colnames(human_avg)),
          all(chicken_order %in% colnames(chicken_avg)))

human_matched   <- human_avg[genes_use, human_order, drop = FALSE]
chicken_matched <- chicken_avg[genes_use, chicken_order, drop = FALSE]

cat("--- Calculating Spearman correlation matrix ---\n")
cor_matrix <- cor(as.matrix(human_matched), as.matrix(chicken_matched), method = "spearman")

cat("--- Generating Heatmap ---\n")
graphics.off()
heatmap_colors <- colorRampPalette(c("#1B9E77", "#FFFFFF", "#D95F02"))(100)

pdf("./Results/S.Fig_4E.pdf", width = 7, height = 6)
pheatmap(
  cor_matrix,
  color = heatmap_colors,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  display_numbers = TRUE,
  number_format = "%.2f",
  fontsize_number = 10,
  fontsize_row = 12,
  fontsize_col = 12,
  border_color = "grey60",
  main = "Spearman Correlation: Human vs Chicken Erythroid Clusters"
)
dev.off()

cat("--- Saving correlation data to Excel ---\n")
write.xlsx(
  list("correlation_matrix" = as.data.frame(cor_matrix)),
  "./Results/Result_Supporting_Files/Human_Chicken_Correlation_Analysis.xlsx",
  rowNames = TRUE
)



# free memory from earlier sections (objects are re-read from disk when needed)
rm(list = intersect(c("Full_data", "HscRNA_1", "HscRNA", "HscRNA_red", "HscRNA_markers",
                      "mat", "results", "BMscRNA_PBscRNA", "cp10k", "human_avg",
                      "chicken_avg", "human_matched", "chicken_matched", "top20"),
                    ls()))
gc()


# ==============================================================================
# SCRIPT 4D: UNIFIED CROSS-SPECIES UMAP (HUMAN + CHICKEN)
# ==============================================================================
# Integrate human and chicken erythroid cells on shared one-to-one orthologs
# to test whether maturation stages align across species.

set.seed(42)
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(Matrix)
cat("--- Loading datasets ---\n")
human   <- readRDS("./Processed_Objects/HscRNA.rds")
chicken <- readRDS("./Processed_Objects/BMscRNA_PBscRNA.rds")

cat("--- Mapping chicken genes to human symbols ---\n")
cts <- get_chicken_counts(chicken)

# Keep only genes present in ALL counts layers
lay <- grep("^counts", Layers(chicken[["RNA"]]), value = TRUE)
layer_genes <- lapply(lay, function(l) rownames(LayerData(chicken, assay = "RNA", layer = l)))
cat("genes per layer:", sapply(layer_genes, length), "\n")
common_layer_genes <- Reduce(intersect, layer_genes)
cat("union:", nrow(cts), "| common to all layers:", length(common_layer_genes), "\n")
cts <- cts[common_layer_genes, ]

m   <- chicken_rows_to_human(rownames(cts))
res <- collapse_counts_to_human(cts, m)

# Genes shared by human and chicken; subset both
shared <- intersect(rownames(human), rownames(res$counts))
cat("genes shared by human and chicken:", length(shared), "\n")
chicken_counts_sub <- res$counts[shared, ]
human <- subset(human, features = shared)

# Ortholog testability table (used by later scripts)
testable <- m %>% group_by(human_symbol) %>%
  summarise(testable_in_PB = any(in_PB),
            low_confidence = any(confidence == "0", na.rm = TRUE))
saveRDS(testable, "./Processed_Objects/ortholog_testability.rds")

cat("--- Applying standardized stage names ---\n")

# Chicken
chicken_ortho <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = chicken_counts_sub, project = "Chicken")
chicken_names <- c(
  "5" = "Erythroid progenitor 1", "3" = "Erythroid progenitor 2",
  "8" = "Early erythroblast",     "2" = "Late erythroblast",
  "4" = "Early polychromatic blast", "1" = "Mid polychromatic blast",
  "0" = "Late polychromatic blast",  "6" = "Immature erythrocyte",
  "9" = "Mature erythrocyte-C"
)
chicken_ortho$stage <- plyr::revalue(as.character(Idents(chicken)[colnames(chicken_ortho)]), chicken_names)
stopifnot(all(chicken_ortho$stage %in% unname(chicken_names)))  # no leftover numbers or NA
print(table(chicken_ortho$stage))
chicken_ortho$species <- "Chicken"

# Human
human_names <- c(
  "5" = "MEP", "1" = "BFU-E", "2" = "CFU-E", "8" = "Proerythroblast",
  "6" = "Basophilic Erythroblast", "0" = "Polychromatic Erythroblast",
  "4" = "Orthochromatic Erythroblast", "9" = "Reticulocyte",
  "10" = "Mature erythrocyte-H"
)
human$stage <- plyr::revalue(as.character(Idents(human)), human_names)
stopifnot(all(human$stage %in% unname(human_names)))
print(table(human$stage))
human$species <- "Human"

cat("--- Cross-species integration (dims 1:10) ---\n")
obj_list <- list(Human = human, Chicken = chicken_ortho)

# SCTransform per species
obj_list <- lapply(obj_list, function(x) {
  SCTransform(x, verbose = FALSE, method = "glmGamPoi", variable.features.n = 3000)
})

features <- SelectIntegrationFeatures(object.list = obj_list, nfeatures = 3000)
obj_list <- PrepSCTIntegration(object.list = obj_list, anchor.features = features)

set.seed(42)
anchors <- FindIntegrationAnchors(
  object.list = obj_list,
  normalization.method = "SCT",
  anchor.features = features,
  reference = 1,          # human
  reduction = "cca",
  dims = 1:10
)
integrated_obj <- IntegrateData(anchorset = anchors, normalization.method = "SCT", dims = 1:10)

integrated_obj <- RunPCA(integrated_obj, verbose = FALSE)
integrated_obj <- RunUMAP(integrated_obj, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:10)

maturation_order <- c(
  "MEP", "Erythroid progenitor 1", "Erythroid progenitor 2", "BFU-E", "CFU-E",
  "Proerythroblast", "Early erythroblast", "Basophilic Erythroblast",
  "Late erythroblast", "Polychromatic Erythroblast", "Early polychromatic blast",
  "Mid polychromatic blast", "Orthochromatic Erythroblast", "Late polychromatic blast",
  "Immature erythrocyte", "Reticulocyte", "Mature erythrocyte-H", "Mature erythrocyte-C"
)
integrated_obj$stage <- factor(integrated_obj$stage, levels = maturation_order)

# Panel A: species mixing
p1 <- DimPlot(integrated_obj, reduction = "umap", group.by = "species",
              cols = c("#1b9e77", "#d95f02")) +
  theme_classic() + ggtitle("Unified Cross-Species Manifold (1:10)") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, hjust = 0.5))

# Panel B: stage alignment
p2 <- DimPlot(integrated_obj, reduction = "umap", group.by = "stage",
              label = TRUE, label.size = 3, repel = TRUE, label.box = TRUE) +
  theme_classic() + NoLegend() + ggtitle("Homologous Maturation path") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, hjust = 0.5))

ggsave("./Results/Fig.3A.pdf", p1 + p2, width = 10, height = 6)
saveRDS(integrated_obj, "./Processed_Objects/Unified_Atlas.rds")

cat("--- 4D complete: Unified_Atlas.rds and Fig.3A.pdf saved ---\n")

# ==============================================================================
# SCRIPT 4E: TF ACTIVITY PROFILING (VIPER + DoRothEA) AND CROSS-SPECIES SRF TRAJECTORY
# ==============================================================================
#   (i)  Infer transcription factor (TF) activity along human erythroid
#        maturation from the expression of regulon targets (VIPER + DoRothEA,
#        confidence A and B), and export the 50 most variable TFs.
#   (ii) Compare SRF along maturation in both species: inferred TF activity in
#        human versus mRNA expression of the SRF ortholog in chicken.
#
target_tf <- "SRF"

cat("Loading Seurat objects...\n")
human_seurat   <- readRDS("./Processed_Objects/HscRNA.rds")
chicken_seurat <- readRDS("./Processed_Objects/BMscRNA_PBscRNA.rds")

# --- Stage names and maturation order -------------------------------------------
custom_order_human <- c("MEP", "BFU-E", "CFU-E", "Proerythroblast",
                        "Basophilic Erythroblast", "Polychromatic Erythroblast",
                        "Orthochromatic Erythroblast", "Reticulocyte", "Mature erythrocyte-H")
human_seurat$cell_type <- plyr::mapvalues(
  x = as.character(human_seurat$seurat_clusters),
  from = as.character(c(5, 1, 2, 8, 6, 0, 4, 9, 10)), to = custom_order_human)
human_seurat$cell_type <- factor(human_seurat$cell_type, levels = custom_order_human)
Idents(human_seurat) <- "cell_type"

custom_order_chicken <- c("Erythroid progenitor 1", "Erythroid progenitor 2", "Early erythroblast",
                          "Late erythroblast", "Early polychromatic blast", "Mid polychromatic blast",
                          "Late polychromatic blast", "Immature erythrocyte", "Mature erythrocyte-C")
chicken_seurat$cell_type <- plyr::mapvalues(
  x = as.character(chicken_seurat$seurat_clusters),
  from = as.character(c(5, 3, 8, 2, 4, 1, 0, 6, 9)), to = custom_order_chicken)
chicken_seurat$cell_type <- factor(chicken_seurat$cell_type, levels = custom_order_chicken)
Idents(chicken_seurat) <- "cell_type"

# --- Human TF activity (VIPER + DoRothEA) ----------------------------------------
# High-confidence regulons (A and B) so inferred activities rest on strong evidence
cat("Calculating VIPER activity for Human...\n")
data(dorothea_hs, package = "dorothea")
regulons <- dorothea_hs %>% dplyr::filter(confidence %in% c("A", "B"))
tf_regulons <- regulons %>%
  split(.$tf) %>%
  lapply(function(x) {
    mor <- x$mor
    names(mor) <- x$target
    list(tfmode = mor, likelihood = rep(1, length(mor)))
  })

expr_matrix <- as.matrix(GetAssayData(human_seurat, assay = "RNA", layer = "data"))
expr_matrix <- expr_matrix[is.finite(rowSums(expr_matrix)), ]
tf_activity_scores <- viper(expr_matrix, tf_regulons, minsize = 4, verbose = FALSE)
human_seurat[["viper"]] <- CreateAssayObject(data = tf_activity_scores)
stopifnot(target_tf %in% rownames(human_seurat[["viper"]]))   # SRF regulon must pass minsize

# --- Top 50 variable TFs and export -----------------------------------------------
cat("Selecting top variable TFs...\n")
DefaultAssay(human_seurat) <- "viper"
human_seurat <- ScaleData(human_seurat, verbose = FALSE)
scaled_viper <- GetAssayData(human_seurat, assay = "viper", layer = "scale.data")
tf_variance  <- apply(scaled_viper, 1, var)
top_50_tfs   <- names(sort(tf_variance, decreasing = TRUE))[1:50]

cat("Exporting to Excel...\n")
tf_top50 <- as.data.frame(t(scaled_viper[top_50_tfs, ]))
tf_top50$Cell      <- rownames(tf_top50)
tf_top50$Cell_Type <- as.character(human_seurat$cell_type[rownames(tf_top50)])
tf_top50 <- tf_top50 %>% dplyr::relocate(Cell, Cell_Type)
openxlsx::write.xlsx(tf_top50, "./Results/Supplementary_Data-17.xlsx", rowNames = FALSE)

# --- Chicken ortholog of the target TF -------------------------------------------
cat("Mapping ortholog for:", target_tf, "\n")
orth <- readr::read_tsv("./External_Data_File/orthologs_ALL_ensembl111.tsv", show_col_types = FALSE)
hit  <- orth %>% dplyr::filter(human_symbol == target_tf)
print(as.data.frame(hit))

chicken_ortholog <- unique(hit$chicken_symbol[hit$chicken_symbol %in% rownames(chicken_seurat[["RNA"]])])
stopifnot(length(chicken_ortholog) == 1)   # exactly one chicken gene, so one line per stage

# --- SRF trajectory data -----------------------------------------------------------
cat("Extracting trajectory data...\n")
DefaultAssay(human_seurat) <- "viper"
human_data <- DotPlot(human_seurat, features = target_tf)$data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(species = "Human")

DefaultAssay(chicken_seurat) <- "RNA"
chicken_data <- DotPlot(chicken_seurat, features = chicken_ortholog)$data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(species = "Chicken")

# --- Plots ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
make_traj_plot <- function(df, order, color, title, ylab) {
  df$id <- factor(df$id, levels = order)
  ggplot(df, aes(x = id, y = avg.exp.scaled, group = 1)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.2, color = color) +
    geom_point(size = 4, color = color) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)) +
    labs(title = title, y = ylab, x = NULL)
}

p_human   <- make_traj_plot(human_data,   custom_order_human,   "#de2d26", "Human",   "Inferred SRF Activity")
p_chicken <- make_traj_plot(chicken_data, custom_order_chicken, "#3182bd", "Chicken", "SRF mRNA Expression")

ggsave("./Results/S.Fig_5F.pdf", p_human | p_chicken, width = 8, height = 5)
cat("--- 4E complete: Supplementary_Data-17.xlsx and S.Fig_5F.pdf saved ---\n")


# ==============================================================================
# SCRIPT 4F: CONSERVED AND DIVERGENT STAGE-MATCHED MARKER ANALYSIS
# ==============================================================================
#   For each of 9 matched human-chicken maturation stage pairs, identify
#   (i) markers conserved in both species and (ii) genes that differ directly
#   between species.

set.seed(42)

# --- Settings ----------------------------------------------------------------
LOGFC_CUT  <- 0.4    # marker log2FC cutoff, required in BOTH species
PADJ_CUT   <- 0.05   # adjusted p-value cutoff
DE_LOGFC   <- 0.5    # log2FC cutoff for direct Human vs Chicken signature
MIN_PCT    <- 0.1    # minimum fraction of cells expressing the gene (speed-up)
LOGFC_TEST <- 0.25   # pre-filter passed to FindMarkers
TOP_N      <- 3      # genes per stage pair shown in the dot plot
stopifnot(LOGFC_TEST < LOGFC_CUT)   # otherwise the pre-filter would hide valid markers

stage_pairs <- data.frame(
  pair_id = paste0("S", 1:9),
  human_stage = c("MEP", "BFU-E", "CFU-E", "Proerythroblast",
                  "Basophilic Erythroblast", "Polychromatic Erythroblast",
                  "Orthochromatic Erythroblast", "Reticulocyte", "Mature erythrocyte-H"),
  chicken_stage = c("Erythroid progenitor 1", "Erythroid progenitor 2", "Early erythroblast",
                    "Late erythroblast", "Early polychromatic blast", "Mid polychromatic blast",
                    "Late polychromatic blast", "Immature erythrocyte", "Mature erythrocyte-C"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# --- Load atlas ----------------------------------------------------------------
cat("--- Loading Unified Atlas ---\n")
integrated_obj <- readRDS("./Processed_Objects/Unified_Atlas.rds")
DefaultAssay(integrated_obj) <- "RNA"
integrated_obj <- JoinLayers(integrated_obj)    # Seurat v5
integrated_obj <- NormalizeData(integrated_obj)
integrated_obj$stage <- as.character(integrated_obj$stage)

# Every pair stage must exist in the right species
stopifnot(all(stage_pairs$human_stage   %in% integrated_obj$stage[integrated_obj$species == "Human"]),
          all(stage_pairs$chicken_stage %in% integrated_obj$stage[integrated_obj$species == "Chicken"]))
cat("Cells per stage and species:\n")
print(table(integrated_obj$stage, integrated_obj$species))

# Each species is tested against its own background (stage vs all other stages)
human_obj   <- subset(integrated_obj, species == "Human")
chicken_obj <- subset(integrated_obj, species == "Chicken")
Idents(human_obj)   <- "stage"
Idents(chicken_obj) <- "stage"

get_markers <- function(obj, stage_name, label) {
  tryCatch(
    FindMarkers(obj, ident.1 = stage_name, only.pos = TRUE,
                logfc.threshold = LOGFC_TEST, min.pct = MIN_PCT, verbose = FALSE),
    error = function(e) {
      message("FindMarkers failed for ", label, " / ", stage_name, ": ", conditionMessage(e))
      NULL
    })
}

# --- Conserved markers ---------------------------------------------------------
cat("--- Conserved markers, stage by stage ---\n")
conserved_list <- list()
summary_list   <- list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(stage_pairs))) {
  pid <- stage_pairs$pair_id[i]
  hs  <- stage_pairs$human_stage[i]
  cs  <- stage_pairs$chicken_stage[i]
  cat(sprintf("  %s: %s (Human) vs %s (Chicken)\n", pid, hs, cs))

  hm <- get_markers(human_obj,   hs, "Human")
  cm <- get_markers(chicken_obj, cs, "Chicken")
  if (is.null(hm) || is.null(cm)) next

  h_genes <- rownames(hm)[hm$avg_log2FC > LOGFC_CUT & hm$p_val_adj < PADJ_CUT]
  c_genes <- rownames(cm)[cm$avg_log2FC > LOGFC_CUT & cm$p_val_adj < PADJ_CUT]
  shared  <- intersect(h_genes, c_genes)
  cat(sprintf("    human %d | chicken %d | conserved %d\n",
              length(h_genes), length(c_genes), length(shared)))

  summary_list[[pid]] <- data.frame(pair_id = pid, human_stage = hs, chicken_stage = cs,
                                    human_markers = length(h_genes),
                                    chicken_markers = length(c_genes),
                                    conserved = length(shared))
  if (length(shared) > 0) {
    conserved_list[[pid]] <- data.frame(
      gene = shared, pair_id = pid, human_stage = hs, chicken_stage = cs,
      human_logFC   = hm[shared, "avg_log2FC"], human_p_adj   = hm[shared, "p_val_adj"],
      chicken_logFC = cm[shared, "avg_log2FC"], chicken_p_adj = cm[shared, "p_val_adj"],
      row.names = NULL)
  }
}

final_conserved_df <- bind_rows(conserved_list)
pair_summary       <- bind_rows(summary_list)
cat("Total conserved marker rows:", nrow(final_conserved_df), "\n")
print(pair_summary)

# --- Direct Human vs Chicken DE ------------------------------------------------
cat("--- Direct Human vs Chicken DE, stage by stage ---\n")
direct_de_list <- list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(stage_pairs))) {
  pid <- stage_pairs$pair_id[i]
  hs  <- stage_pairs$human_stage[i]
  cs  <- stage_pairs$chicken_stage[i]

  keep <- colnames(integrated_obj)[
    (integrated_obj$species == "Human"   & integrated_obj$stage == hs) |
    (integrated_obj$species == "Chicken" & integrated_obj$stage == cs)]
  sub_obj <- subset(integrated_obj, cells = keep)
  Idents(sub_obj) <- "species"
  if (length(unique(Idents(sub_obj))) < 2) next

  de_res <- tryCatch(
    FindMarkers(sub_obj, ident.1 = "Human", ident.2 = "Chicken",
                logfc.threshold = 0, min.pct = MIN_PCT, verbose = FALSE),
    error = function(e) { message("Direct DE failed for ", pid, ": ", conditionMessage(e)); NULL })
  if (is.null(de_res)) next

  de_res$gene          <- rownames(de_res)
  de_res$pair_id       <- pid
  de_res$human_stage   <- hs
  de_res$chicken_stage <- cs
  de_res <- de_res %>% mutate(Signature = case_when(
    avg_log2FC >  DE_LOGFC & p_val_adj < PADJ_CUT ~ "Human-Enriched",
    avg_log2FC < -DE_LOGFC & p_val_adj < PADJ_CUT ~ "Chicken-Enriched",
    TRUE ~ "Non-Significant/Divergent"))
  direct_de_list[[pid]] <- de_res
}
all_direct_de <- bind_rows(direct_de_list)

write.xlsx(list("Pair_Summary" = pair_summary,
                "Conserved_Shared_Markers" = final_conserved_df,
                "Direct_DE_Signatures" = all_direct_de),
           "./Results/Supplementary Data 10.xlsx")

# --- Dot plot of top conserved markers ------------------------------------------
if (nrow(final_conserved_df) > 0) {
  feat <- c()
  for (pid in stage_pairs$pair_id) {
    g <- final_conserved_df %>% filter(pair_id == pid) %>%
      arrange(human_p_adj + chicken_p_adj, desc(human_logFC + chicken_logFC)) %>%
      head(TOP_N) %>% pull(gene)
    feat <- c(feat, g)
  }
  feat <- unique(feat)   # DotPlot cannot take duplicated features
  cat("Plotting", length(feat), "genes.\n")

  # One row per stage: pair id + stage name, human then chicken
  integrated_obj$row_label <- NA_character_
  row_levels <- c()
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(stage_pairs))) {
    hl <- paste0(stage_pairs$pair_id[i], " | ", stage_pairs$human_stage[i], " (Human)")
    cl <- paste0(stage_pairs$pair_id[i], " | ", stage_pairs$chicken_stage[i], " (Chicken)")
    integrated_obj$row_label[integrated_obj$species == "Human" &
                             integrated_obj$stage == stage_pairs$human_stage[i]] <- hl
    integrated_obj$row_label[integrated_obj$species == "Chicken" &
                             integrated_obj$stage == stage_pairs$chicken_stage[i]] <- cl
    row_levels <- c(row_levels, hl, cl)
  }
  integrated_obj$row_label <- factor(integrated_obj$row_label, levels = rev(row_levels))

  p_final <- DotPlot(integrated_obj, features = feat, group.by = "row_label",
                     cols = c("lightblue", "red"), dot.scale = 6) +
    RotatedAxis() + theme_bw() +
    labs(title = "Stage-Matched Conserved Markers (Human vs Chicken)",
         subtitle = paste0("Top ", TOP_N, " per stage pair; log2FC>", LOGFC_CUT,
                           ", FDR<", PADJ_CUT, " in both species"),
         x = "Conserved markers (ordered by stage pair)", y = "") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9, angle = 60, hjust = 1, face = "italic"),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 15),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 11))

  ggsave("./Results/Fig_3B.pdf", p_final, width = 14, height = 8)
}

cat("--- 4F complete: Supplementary Data 10 and Fig_3B.pdf saved ---\n")

# ==============================================================================
# SCRIPT 4G: CONSERVED TRANSCRIPTIONAL KINETICS (SHAPE-MATCHED, PERMUTATION-TESTED)
# ==============================================================================
#   Identify genes whose expression trajectory across the 9 matched maturation
#   stages has the same shape in human and chicken.
# ==============================================================================

set.seed(2026)
graphics.off()

# --- Settings ----------------------------------------------------------------
MIN_EXPR  <- 0.1     # min. peak average expression required in each species
N_PERM    <- 2000    # permutations for the empirical p-value
FDR_CUT   <- 0.05
R_STRICT  <- 0.7     # primary Spearman r cutoff
R_RELAXED <- 0.5     # fallback if no gene passes R_STRICT
TOP_N_HM  <- 30      # genes shown in the heatmap
BLACKLIST <- c("^HB[AB]", "^HBE", "^RPL", "^RPS", "^MT-", "MALAT1")

h_stages <- c("MEP", "BFU-E", "CFU-E", "Proerythroblast", "Basophilic Erythroblast",
              "Polychromatic Erythroblast", "Orthochromatic Erythroblast",
              "Reticulocyte", "Mature erythrocyte-H")
c_stages <- c("Erythroid progenitor 1", "Erythroid progenitor 2", "Early erythroblast",
              "Late erythroblast", "Early polychromatic blast", "Mid polychromatic blast",
              "Late polychromatic blast", "Immature erythrocyte", "Mature erythrocyte-C")

# --- Average expression per species x stage ------------------------------------
cat("--- Loading Unified Atlas ---\n")
integrated_obj <- readRDS("./Processed_Objects/Unified_Atlas.rds")
assay_names <- names(integrated_obj@assays)   # works in every Seurat version
print(assay_names)
stopifnot("SCT" %in% assay_names)
DefaultAssay(integrated_obj) <- "SCT"
integrated_obj$stage_species <- paste0(integrated_obj$species, "_", integrated_obj$stage)

avg_exp <- as.matrix(AverageExpression(integrated_obj, group.by = "stage_species",
                                       assays = "SCT")$SCT)

# AverageExpression may rewrite column names (e.g. "_" -> "-"), so match on
# names with all non-alphanumeric characters removed
normalize_name <- function(x) gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "", x)
match_cols <- function(expected) {
  hit <- match(normalize_name(expected), normalize_name(colnames(avg_exp)))
  if (anyNA(hit)) stop("Could not match stage columns: ", paste(expected[is.na(hit)], collapse = ", "))
  colnames(avg_exp)[hit]
}
h_cols <- match_cols(paste0("Human_",   h_stages))
c_cols <- match_cols(paste0("Chicken_", c_stages))

# --- Gene filtering ------------------------------------------------------------
genes <- rownames(avg_exp)
genes <- genes[!grepl(paste(BLACKLIST, collapse = "|"), genes)]
h_max <- apply(avg_exp[genes, h_cols, drop = FALSE], 1, max)
c_max <- apply(avg_exp[genes, c_cols, drop = FALSE], 1, max)
genes <- genes[h_max > MIN_EXPR & c_max > MIN_EXPR]

h_mat <- avg_exp[genes, h_cols, drop = FALSE]
c_mat <- avg_exp[genes, c_cols, drop = FALSE]
keep  <- apply(h_mat, 1, sd) > 0 & apply(c_mat, 1, sd) > 0
h_mat <- h_mat[keep, , drop = FALSE]
c_mat <- c_mat[keep, , drop = FALSE]
cat("Genes tested (detected, non-constant in both species):", nrow(h_mat), "\n")
if (nrow(h_mat) == 0) stop("No genes passed the filters.")

# --- Spearman r and permutation test -------------------------------------------
rank_and_scale <- function(mat) t(scale(t(t(apply(mat, 1, rank)))))
h_scaled <- rank_and_scale(h_mat)
c_scaled <- rank_and_scale(c_mat)
n_stages <- ncol(h_scaled)

# Pearson correlation of the rank-scaled values = Spearman correlation
row_cor <- function(A, B) rowMeans(A * B) * (n_stages / (n_stages - 1))
obs_cor <- row_cor(h_scaled, c_scaled)

perm_cor <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = nrow(c_scaled), ncol = N_PERM)
for (k in seq_len(N_PERM)) {
  perm_cor[, k] <- row_cor(h_scaled, c_scaled[, sample(n_stages), drop = FALSE])
}
emp_p <- (rowSums(abs(perm_cor) >= abs(obs_cor)) + 1) / (N_PERM + 1)

results_df <- data.frame(gene = rownames(h_scaled), spearman_r = obs_cor,
                         p_value = emp_p, p_adj_fdr = p.adjust(emp_p, method = "fdr")) %>%
  arrange(desc(spearman_r))
write.xlsx(results_df, "./Results/Supplementary Data 11.xlsx")

# --- Select genes (significant and positively correlated) ------------------------
r_used <- R_STRICT
sig_genes <- results_df %>% filter(p_adj_fdr < FDR_CUT, spearman_r > r_used) %>% pull(gene)
if (length(sig_genes) == 0) {
  r_used <- R_RELAXED
  cat("No gene passed r >", R_STRICT, "- relaxing to r >", R_RELAXED, "\n")
  sig_genes <- results_df %>% filter(p_adj_fdr < FDR_CUT, spearman_r > r_used) %>% pull(gene)
}
if (length(sig_genes) == 0) stop("No genes passed even the relaxed threshold.")
cat("Genes tested:", nrow(results_df), "| passing FDR <", FDR_CUT, "and r >", r_used, ":", length(sig_genes), "\n")

top_genes <- sig_genes[seq_len(min(TOP_N_HM, length(sig_genes)))]   # ordered by r

# --- Heatmap (each species z-scored separately) -----------------------------------
z_score <- function(x) t(apply(x, 1, function(r) if (sd(r) == 0) rep(0, length(r)) else (r - mean(r)) / sd(r)))
raw_mat <- avg_exp[top_genes, c(h_cols, c_cols), drop = FALSE]
final_matrix <- cbind(z_score(raw_mat[, h_cols, drop = FALSE]),
                      z_score(raw_mat[, c_cols, drop = FALSE]))
colnames(final_matrix) <- c(h_stages, c_stages)

row_annot <- data.frame(Spearman_r = results_df$spearman_r[match(top_genes, results_df$gene)],
                        row.names = top_genes)
stopifnot(identical(rownames(row_annot), rownames(final_matrix)))

pdf("./Results/S.Fig_6A.pdf", width = 14, height = 9)
pheatmap(
  final_matrix,
  cluster_cols = FALSE, cluster_rows = FALSE,
  main = paste0("Conserved Transcriptional Kinetics (Shape Only): Human vs Chicken\n",
                "FDR<", FDR_CUT, ", Spearman r>", r_used, ", n=", length(top_genes),
                " genes (", nrow(results_df), " tested)\n",
                "Each species independently z-scored - not comparable for magnitude of change"),
  color = colorRampPalette(c("#4575b4", "#ffffbf", "#d73027"))(100),
  border_color = "white",
  cellwidth = 20, cellheight = 15,
  fontsize = 10, fontsize_row = 10, fontsize_col = 10,
  annotation_row = row_annot,
  gaps_col = length(h_cols)
)
dev.off()

cat("--- 4G complete: Supplementary Data 11 and S.Fig_6A.pdf saved ---\n")

# ==============================================================================
# SCRIPT 4H: MATURATION VOLATILITY ANALYSIS (STAGE-MATCHED)
# ==============================================================================
#   Compare how strongly gene expression changes between consecutive matched
#   maturation stages in human and chicken.
#
cat("--- Running Maturation Intensity (Volatility) Analysis ---\n")

integrated_obj <- readRDS("./Processed_Objects/Unified_Atlas.rds")
DefaultAssay(integrated_obj) <- "RNA"
integrated_obj <- JoinLayers(integrated_obj)    # Seurat v5
integrated_obj <- NormalizeData(integrated_obj)
integrated_obj$stage <- as.character(integrated_obj$stage)

stage_pairs <- data.frame(
  pair_id = paste0("S", 1:9),
  human_stage = c("MEP", "BFU-E", "CFU-E", "Proerythroblast",
                  "Basophilic Erythroblast", "Polychromatic Erythroblast",
                  "Orthochromatic Erythroblast", "Reticulocyte", "Mature erythrocyte-H"),
  chicken_stage = c("Erythroid progenitor 1", "Erythroid progenitor 2", "Early erythroblast",
                    "Late erythroblast", "Early polychromatic blast", "Mid polychromatic blast",
                    "Late polychromatic blast", "Immature erythrocyte", "Mature erythrocyte-C"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
h_path <- stage_pairs$human_stage
c_path <- stage_pairs$chicken_stage
ids    <- stage_pairs$pair_id

stopifnot(all(h_path %in% integrated_obj$stage[integrated_obj$species == "Human"]),
          all(c_path %in% integrated_obj$stage[integrated_obj$species == "Chicken"]))

# Differential expression between each stage and the next one, within one species
calc_vol <- function(obj, species_name, stages, ids) {
  res <- lapply(seq_len(length(stages) - 1), function(i) {
    m <- FindMarkers(obj, ident.1 = stages[i + 1], ident.2 = stages[i],
                     group.by = "stage", logfc.threshold = 0, min.pct = 0.05,
                     verbose = FALSE)
    m$gene       <- rownames(m)
    m$species    <- species_name
    m$from_stage <- stages[i]
    m$to_stage   <- stages[i + 1]
    m$transition <- paste0(ids[i], " \u2192 ", ids[i + 1])
    m
  })
  bind_rows(res)
}

vol_combined <- bind_rows(
  calc_vol(subset(integrated_obj, species == "Human"),   "Human",   h_path, ids),
  calc_vol(subset(integrated_obj, species == "Chicken"), "Chicken", c_path, ids))

# S1 -> S2 at the top of the plot
trans_levels <- paste0(ids[-length(ids)], " \u2192 ", ids[-1])
vol_combined$transition <- factor(vol_combined$transition, levels = rev(trans_levels))

# --- Ridge plot ----------------------------------------------------------------
cat("--- Generating ridge plot ---\n")
p_ridges <- ggplot(vol_combined, aes(x = abs(avg_log2FC), y = transition, fill = species)) +
  geom_density_ridges(alpha = 0.7, color = "white", scale = 1.4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Human" = "#1b9e77", "Chicken" = "#d95f02")) +
  theme_ridges(font_size = 12) + xlim(0, 4) +
  labs(title = "Stage-Matched Maturation Volatility",
       subtitle = "Distribution of |log2FC| between consecutive matched stages",
       x = "Magnitude of Change (|Log2FC|)", y = "Matched stage transition")

ggsave("./Results/Fig_3D.pdf", p_ridges, width = 8, height = 7)

# Summary statistics ----------------------------------------------------------
vol_stats_detailed <- vol_combined %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::group_by(species, transition) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(
    Total_Genes      = dplyr::n(),
    Mean_Abs_LogFC   = mean(abs(avg_log2FC), na.rm = TRUE),
    Median_Abs_LogFC = median(abs(avg_log2FC), na.rm = TRUE),
    Std_Dev          = sd(abs(avg_log2FC), na.rm = TRUE),
    Extreme_Count    = sum(abs(avg_log2FC) > 2),
    Percent_Extreme  = Extreme_Count / Total_Genes * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write.csv(vol_stats_detailed, "./Results/Supplementary Data 12.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("--- 4H complete: Fig_3D.pdf and Supplementary Data 12 saved ---\n")


# ==============================================================================
# SCRIPT 4I: MATCHED ANALYSIS OF STAGE TRANSITIONS ON THE UNIFIED ATLAS
# ==============================================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(openxlsx)
  library(clusterProfiler)
  library(org.Hs.eg.db)
})
# plyr (loaded earlier in your session) masks dplyr verbs; summarise() in particular
# silently drops the grouping. Pin the dplyr versions explicitly.
select <- dplyr::select; filter <- dplyr::filter; mutate <- dplyr::mutate
summarise <- dplyr::summarise; summarize <- dplyr::summarise; arrange <- dplyr::arrange
rename <- dplyr::rename; count <- dplyr::count; group_by <- dplyr::group_by
set.seed(42)

# Settings --------------------------------------------------------------
N_CELLS   <- 300      # max cells per stage per species (same for both species)
N_REPEATS <- 5        # number of random downsampling repeats
PADJ      <- 0.05
LFC       <- 0.5      # |log2FC| for a DEG (same as SCRIPT 4P)
MIN_PCT   <- 0.1
OUT <- "./Results/"
dir.create(OUT, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

stage_pairs <- data.frame(
  pair_id = paste0("S", 1:9),
  human_stage = c("MEP", "BFU-E", "CFU-E", "Proerythroblast",
                  "Basophilic Erythroblast", "Polychromatic Erythroblast",
                  "Orthochromatic Erythroblast", "Reticulocyte", "Mature erythrocyte-H"),
  chicken_stage = c("Erythroid progenitor 1", "Erythroid progenitor 2", "Early erythroblast",
                    "Late erythroblast", "Early polychromatic blast", "Mid polychromatic blast",
                    "Late polychromatic blast", "Immature erythrocyte", "Mature erythrocyte-C"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Load the unified atlas (RNA assay, same as 4F / 4H) ---------------------
atlas <- readRDS("./Processed_Objects/Unified_Atlas.rds")
DefaultAssay(atlas) <- "RNA"
atlas <- JoinLayers(atlas)
atlas <- NormalizeData(atlas)
atlas$stage <- as.character(atlas$stage)

# The warning "Different cells in new layer data than already exists" can mean a stale
# 'data' layer. Make sure the normalised layer covers ALL cells before testing.
dl <- LayerData(atlas, assay = "RNA", layer = "data")
cat("CHECK: data layer dims:", dim(dl), "| atlas cells:", ncol(atlas), "\n")
stopifnot(ncol(dl) == ncol(atlas), setequal(colnames(dl), colnames(atlas)))
rm(dl)

stopifnot(all(stage_pairs$human_stage   %in% atlas$stage[atlas$species == "Human"]),
          all(stage_pairs$chicken_stage %in% atlas$stage[atlas$species == "Chicken"]))

meta <- atlas@meta.data
meta$cell <- rownames(meta)
cat("CHECK: cells per stage and species\n")
print(table(meta$stage, meta$species))

# Helpers ---------------------------------------------------------------
# FindMarkers.Seurat() has no cells.1/cells.2 arguments, so two cell sets are passed
# through a temporary grouping column.
find_markers_cells <- function(c1, c2) {
  grp <- rep("other", ncol(atlas)); names(grp) <- colnames(atlas)
  grp[c1] <- "g1"; grp[c2] <- "g2"
  atlas$tmp_grp <- grp
  FindMarkers(atlas, ident.1 = "g1", ident.2 = "g2", group.by = "tmp_grp", assay = "RNA",
              test.use = "wilcox", logfc.threshold = 0, min.pct = MIN_PCT, verbose = FALSE)
}

# One transition, optionally on matched/downsampled cells
run_transition <- function(species, from, to, pair_from, pair_to, n_cap,
                           pool = NULL, seed = 1, keep_table = FALSE) {
  m <- meta[meta$species == species, ]
  if (!is.null(pool)) m <- m[m$cell %in% pool, ]
  c1_all <- m$cell[m$stage == to]
  c2_all <- m$cell[m$stage == from]
  n_use  <- min(n_cap, length(c1_all), length(c2_all))
  if (n_use < 3) return(NULL)
  set.seed(seed)
  c1 <- sample(c1_all, n_use); c2 <- sample(c2_all, n_use)

  # logfc.threshold = 0 -> every gene passing min.pct is tested, so the same table
  # gives (a) significant DEGs and (b) the |log2FC|>2 fraction (Fig. 3c metric)
  res <- find_markers_cells(c1, c2)
  res$gene <- rownames(res)
  sig  <- res$p_val_adj < PADJ & abs(res$avg_log2FC) > LFC
  summ <- data.frame(
    species = species, transition = paste0(pair_from, "->", pair_to),
    from = from, to = to, n_cells_per_group = n_use, seed = seed,
    genes_tested = nrow(res),
    up = sum(sig & res$avg_log2FC > 0), down = sum(sig & res$avg_log2FC < 0),
    total_DEGs = sum(sig),
    pct_abs_lfc_gt2 = 100 * mean(abs(res$avg_log2FC) > 2),
    pct_abs_lfc_gt1 = 100 * mean(abs(res$avg_log2FC) > 1),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  if (keep_table) list(summary = summ, table = res) else list(summary = summ)
}

# Main analysis: all 8 consecutive transitions, both species ---------------
# Cell cap per transition is the same for both species (min over the 4 groups),
# so DE power is matched.
cap_for <- function(i) {
  g <- function(sp, st) sum(meta$species == sp & meta$stage == st)
  min(N_CELLS,
      g("Human", stage_pairs$human_stage[i]),   g("Human", stage_pairs$human_stage[i + 1]),
      g("Chicken", stage_pairs$chicken_stage[i]), g("Chicken", stage_pairs$chicken_stage[i + 1]))
}

all_summ <- list(); kept_tables <- list()
for (i in 1:8) {
  cap <- cap_for(i)
  cat(sprintf("Transition S%d->S%d | cells per group (matched across species): %d\n", i, i + 1, cap))
  for (r in seq_len(N_REPEATS)) {
    for (sp in c("Human", "Chicken")) {
      from <- if (sp == "Human") stage_pairs$human_stage[i]   else stage_pairs$chicken_stage[i]
      to   <- if (sp == "Human") stage_pairs$human_stage[i+1] else stage_pairs$chicken_stage[i+1]
      out  <- run_transition(sp, from, to, stage_pairs$pair_id[i], stage_pairs$pair_id[i + 1],
                             n_cap = cap, seed = r, keep_table = (r == 1))
      if (is.null(out)) next
      all_summ[[length(all_summ) + 1]] <- out$summary
      if (r == 1) kept_tables[[paste(sp, out$summary$transition)]] <- out$table
    }
  }
}
deg_summary <- bind_rows(all_summ)

deg_median <- deg_summary %>%
  dplyr::group_by(species, transition) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n_cells_per_group = dplyr::first(n_cells_per_group), genes_tested = round(median(genes_tested)),
            up_median = median(up), down_median = median(down),
            total_median = median(total_DEGs), total_min = min(total_DEGs), total_max = max(total_DEGs),
            pct_lfc_gt2_median = median(pct_abs_lfc_gt2), .groups = "drop")
cat("\n=== MATCHED DEG COUNTS (median over repeats) ===\n")
print(as.data.frame(deg_median))

# Plot: DEG counts per transition, both species ----------------------------
plot_df <- deg_median %>% mutate(transition = factor(transition, levels = paste0("S", 1:8, "->S", 2:9)))
p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(transition, total_median, fill = species)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(0.8), width = 0.75) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = total_min, ymax = total_max), position = position_dodge(0.8), width = 0.25) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(Human = "#1b9e77", Chicken = "#d95f02")) +
  labs(x = "Matched stage transition (chicken S9 = peripheral-blood-derived cluster)",
       y = paste0("DEGs (padj<", PADJ, ", |log2FC|>", LFC, "), matched cells"),
       title = "Stage-matched DEG counts on the unified atlas",
       subtitle = paste0("Equal cells per group per transition (cap ", N_CELLS,
                         "); bars = median, whiskers = range over ", N_REPEATS, " repeats")) +
  theme_classic()
ggsave(file.path(OUT, "Matched_DEG_counts.pdf"), p, width = 9, height = 5)

p2 <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(transition, pct_lfc_gt2_median, fill = species)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(0.8), width = 0.75) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(Human = "#1b9e77", Chicken = "#d95f02")) +
  labs(x = "Matched stage transition", y = "% tested genes with |log2FC| > 2",
       title = "Volatility metric (Fig. 3c style) with matched cells") + theme_classic()
ggsave(file.path(OUT, "Matched_volatility_pct_gt2.pdf"), p2, width = 9, height = 5)

# Enrichment: same universe logic for both species -------------------------
# Both species are already in human gene symbols, so org.Hs.eg.db is used for both.
# Universe = genes tested in that comparison (not the whole genome).
run_go <- function(genes, universe, label) {
  if (length(genes) < 10) return(NULL)
  e <- tryCatch(enrichGO(gene = genes, universe = universe, OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db, keyType = "SYMBOL",
                         ont = "BP", pAdjustMethod = "BH", pvalueCutoff = 0.05, qvalueCutoff = 0.05,
                         minGSSize = 10, maxGSSize = 500), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(e) || nrow(as.data.frame(e)) == 0) return(NULL)
  mutate(as.data.frame(e), Cluster = label)
}

go_all <- list()
for (nm in names(kept_tables)) {
  tb   <- kept_tables[[nm]]
  univ <- tb$gene
  up   <- tb$gene[tb$p_val_adj < PADJ & tb$avg_log2FC >  LFC]
  down <- tb$gene[tb$p_val_adj < PADJ & tb$avg_log2FC < -LFC]
  go_all[[paste(nm, "up")]]   <- run_go(up,   univ, paste(nm, "up"))
  go_all[[paste(nm, "down")]] <- run_go(down, univ, paste(nm, "down"))
}
go_df <- bind_rows(go_all)

key_terms <- "autophag|mitophag|translation|ribosom|oxidative phosph|respirat|electron transport|cell cycle|DNA replication|oxygen transport|gas transport|mitochond"
go_key <- go_df %>%
  filter(grepl(key_terms, Description, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
  select(Cluster, Description, GeneRatio, BgRatio, FoldEnrichment, p.adjust, Count) %>%
  arrange(Cluster, p.adjust)

# Focus view: the two terminal transitions in both species
focus <- go_key %>% filter(grepl("S7->S8|S8->S9", Cluster))
cat("\n=== KEY TERMS at S7->S8 and S8->S9 (matched analysis) ===\n")
print(as.data.frame(head(focus, 60)))

# Save everything -----------------------------------------------------------
wb <- createWorkbook()
add <- function(name, d) { addWorksheet(wb, name); writeData(wb, name, as.data.frame(d)) }
add("DEG_counts_all_repeats", deg_summary)

if (nrow(go_df))  add("GO_BP_all", go_df)
if (nrow(go_key)) add("GO_key_terms", go_key)
saveWorkbook(wb, file.path(OUT, "Supplementary Data 14.xlsx"), overwrite = TRUE)

# Full DEG tables (repeat 1) for each transition
wb2 <- createWorkbook()
for (nm in names(kept_tables)) {
  sh <- substr(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9>_ -]", "", gsub("->", "_", nm)), 1, 31)
  addWorksheet(wb2, sh); writeData(wb2, sh, kept_tables[[nm]])
}
saveWorkbook(wb2, file.path(OUT, "Supplementary Data 15.xlsx"), overwrite = TRUE)
saveRDS(list(summary = deg_summary, median = deg_median, go = go_df),
        file.path(OUT, "Matched_Reanalysis.rds"))
cat("\n--- 4T complete. Results in:", OUT, "---\n")

# ==============================================================================
# SCRIPT 4J: MECHANISTIC MARKER DOT PLOTS (HUMAN VS CHICKEN)
# ==============================================================================
#   Compare expression of enucleation-related markers (signal, cytoskeletal

cat("--- Loading human and chicken objects ---\n")
human   <- readRDS("./Processed_Objects/HscRNA.rds")
chicken <- readRDS("./Processed_Objects/BMscRNA_PBscRNA.rds")

# Cluster -> stage names

                   "Late polychromatic blast", "Late erythroblast",
                   "Immature erythrocyte", "Mature erythrocyte-C")

# Assign stages, keep erythroid clusters, set RNA assay
prep_obj <- function(x, name_map, stage_levels) {
  st <- unname(name_map[as.character(x$seurat_clusters)])   # NA for clusters not in the map
  x$stage <- st
  x <- subset(x, cells = colnames(x)[!is.na(x$stage)])
  x$stage <- factor(x$stage, levels = stage_levels)
  stopifnot(!any(is.na(x$stage)))

  DefaultAssay(x) <- "RNA"
  x <- tryCatch(JoinLayers(x), error = function(e) x)       # Seurat v5 split layers
  if (!("data" %in% Layers(x[["RNA"]]))) x <- NormalizeData(x)
  x
}

human_obj   <- prep_obj(human,   human_names,   human_order)
chicken_obj <- prep_obj(chicken, chicken_names, chicken_order)

cat("Human cells per stage:\n");   print(table(human_obj$stage))
cat("Chicken cells per stage:\n"); print(table(chicken_obj$stage))

# Marker set, ordered by biological pipeline

)

}

# ==============================================================================
# SCRIPT 4K: HUMAN ERYTHROID TRAJECTORY & PSEUDOTIME (MONOCLE 3)
# ==============================================================================

# Dataset Preparation for Monocle 3
# We reconstruct the human erythroid maturation trajectory to 
# serve as the mammalian benchmark for enucleation-associated gene dynamics.

# Load the processed human erythroid object
HscRNA <- readRDS("./Processed_Objects/HscRNA.rds")
Idents(HscRNA) <- "seurat_clusters"
selected_clusters <- c(5, 1, 2, 8, 6, 0, 4, 9, 10)
HscRNA <- subset(HscRNA, idents = selected_clusters)
# Define maturation labels and explicit factor ordering
new_cluster_names <- c(
  "0" = "Polychromatic Erythroblast", "1" = "BFU-E", "2" = "CFU-E",
  "4" = "Orthochromatic Erythroblast", "5" = "MEP", "6" = "Basophilic Erythroblast",
  "8" = "Proerythroblast", "9" = "Reticulocyte", "10"= "Mature erythrocyte"
)
human_cluster_order <- c(
  "MEP", "BFU-E", "CFU-E", "Proerythroblast",
  "Basophilic Erythroblast", "Polychromatic Erythroblast",
  "Orthochromatic Erythroblast", "Reticulocyte", "Mature erythrocyte"
)
HscRNA$annotated_clusters <- plyr::revalue(as.character(HscRNA$seurat_clusters), new_cluster_names)
HscRNA$annotated_clusters <- factor(HscRNA$annotated_clusters, levels = human_cluster_order)

# Monocle 3 Object Construction & Graph Learning
# We transfer the UMAP coordinates from Seurat to ensure trajectory alignment.
expr_matrix <- as(as.matrix(HscRNA@assays$RNA@counts), 'sparseMatrix')
cell_metadata <- HscRNA@meta.data
gene_metadata <- data.frame(gene_short_name = rownames(expr_matrix), row.names = rownames(expr_matrix))
# Create Monocle3 object
cds <- new_cell_data_set(expr_matrix, cell_metadata, gene_metadata)
cds <- preprocess_cds(cds, method = "PCA")
umap_coords <- Embeddings(HscRNA, reduction = "umap")
reducedDims(cds)$UMAP <- umap_coords
cds <- cluster_cells(cds, reduction_method = "UMAP")
# FORCE SINGLE PARTITION: Ensures the trajectory graph is built across all maturation stages
partition_vector <- factor(rep(1, ncol(cds)))
names(partition_vector) <- colnames(cds) 
colData(cds)$partition <- partition_vector 
cds@clusters$UMAP$partitions <- partition_vector 
cds@clusters$UMAP$cluster_graph <- igraph::make_empty_graph(directed = TRUE) 
# Learn trajectory graph
cds <- learn_graph(
  cds, 
  use_partition = FALSE, 
  learn_graph_control = list(euclidean_distance_ratio = 3.0) 
) 
#  Pseudotime Root Setting & Calculation
# We identify the earliest principal node within the MEP cluster to root the trajectory.
get_earliest_principal_node <- function(cds, cell_cluster) {
  cell_ids <- which(colData(cds)[['annotated_clusters']] == cell_cluster)
  closest_vertex <- cds@principal_graph_aux[['UMAP']]$pr_graph_cell_proj_closest_vertex
  closest_vertex <- as.matrix(closest_vertex[colnames(cds),])
  root_pr_nodes <- igraph::V(principal_graph(cds)[['UMAP']])$name[
    as.numeric(names(which.max(table(closest_vertex[cell_ids,]))))
  ]
  return(root_pr_nodes[1])
}
# Find and set root node
root_node <- get_earliest_principal_node(cds, "MEP")
cds <- order_cells(cds, reduction_method = "UMAP", root_pr_nodes = root_node)

#  Manual Pseudotime Assignment (Safety Net)
# Mature erythrocytes often exhibit low transcript diversity 
# which can skew automated pseudotime. We manually assign them as the terminal state.
pseudotime_data <- cds@colData %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  filter(annotated_clusters %in% c("Reticulocyte", "Orthochromatic Erythroblast"))
max_pseudotime <- max(pseudotime_data$pseudotime, na.rm = TRUE)
if (is.infinite(max_pseudotime) || is.na(max_pseudotime)) {
    max_pseudotime <- max(cds@colData$pseudotime, na.rm=TRUE) 
}
if (is.infinite(max_pseudotime) || is.na(max_pseudotime)) {
    max_pseudotime <- 10 
}
start_time_for_mature <- max_pseudotime + 1 
mature_erythrocyte_cells <- rownames(cds@colData[cds@colData$annotated_clusters == "Mature erythrocyte", ])
if (length(mature_erythrocyte_cells) > 0) {
    message(paste("Manually assigning pseudotime (value:", round(start_time_for_mature, 2), ") to", length(mature_erythrocyte_cells), "Mature Erythrocyte cells."))
    cds@colData[mature_erythrocyte_cells, "pseudotime"] <- start_time_for_mature
}

#  Trajectory Visualization
pdf("./Results/Result_Supporting_Files/Trajactory.pdf", width = 10, height = 8)
plot_cells(cds,
           reduction_method = "UMAP",
           color_cells_by = "annotated_clusters",
           label_groups_by_cluster = FALSE,
           label_cell_groups = FALSE,
           label_leaves = FALSE,
           label_branch_points = FALSE,
           group_label_size = 5) +
  geom_text(
    data = cds@colData %>%
      as.data.frame() %>%
      dplyr::group_by(annotated_clusters) %>%
      dplyr::summarize(UMAP_1 = median(reducedDims(cds)$UMAP[annotated_clusters == unique(annotated_clusters), 1], na.rm=TRUE),
                       UMAP_2 = median(reducedDims(cds)$UMAP[annotated_clusters == unique(annotated_clusters), 2], na.rm=TRUE)),
    aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2, label = annotated_clusters),
    size = 4, color = "black", fontface = "bold"
  )
dev.off()

#  Maturation Marker Dynamics
# We plot key lineage markers across pseudotime using individual scales to capture the loss of progenitor markers and gain of terminal signatures.
AFD_genes_human <- c("CD38", "CD34", "THY1", "IL3RA", "PTPRC", "CD36", "TFRC", "ENG", "KIT", "GYPA", "ITGA4", "GYPB")
AFD_genes_human_present <- AFD_genes_human[AFD_genes_human %in% rownames(cds)]
missing_genes <- setdiff(AFD_genes_human, AFD_genes_human_present)
if (length(missing_genes) > 0) {
  message("These genes are not found in your dataset: ", paste(missing_genes, collapse=", "))
}
# Define gene-specific y-axis scales for high-resolution visualization
gene_scales <- list(
  "THY1" = list(breaks = c(1, 3, 10)),
  "TFRC" = list(breaks = c(1, 3, 10, 30)),
  "PTPRC" = list(breaks = c(1, 3, 10, 30)),
  "KIT" = list(breaks = c(1, 3, 10)),
  "ITGA4" = list(breaks = c(1, 3, 10, 30)),
  "IL3RA" = list(breaks = c(1, 3, 10, 30)),
  "GYPB" = list(breaks = c(1, 3, 10)),
  "GYPA" = list(breaks = c(1, 10, 100)), 
  "ENG" = list(breaks = c(1, 3, 10, 30)),
  "CD38" = list(breaks = c(1, 3, 10)),
  "CD36" = list(breaks = c(1, 3, 10, 30)),
  "CD34" = list(breaks = c(1, 3, 10, 30))
)

default_scale <- list(breaks = c(1, 10, 100), limits = c(0.8, 100))
plots_list <- lapply(AFD_genes_human_present, function(gene) {
  gene_scale <- gene_scales[[gene]]
  if (is.null(gene_scale)) {
    gene_scale <- default_scale
    message(paste("Warning: No custom scale found for", gene, ". Using default scale."))
  } else {
      gene_scale$limits <- c(0.8, max(gene_scale$breaks))
  }
  
  p <- plot_genes_in_pseudotime(cds[gene,], color_cells_by = "annotated_clusters") + 
    scale_y_continuous(
        trans = "log10", 
        breaks = gene_scale$breaks, 
        limits = gene_scale$limits,
        labels = function(x) ifelse(x < 1, format(x, scientific = FALSE), as.character(x))
    ) +
    theme(legend.position = "right") +
    ggtitle(gene)
  return(p)
})

combined_plot <- wrap_plots(plots_list, ncol = 1)

# Save the combined plot
ggsave("./Results/Result_Supporting_Files/Human Makrers Trajactory.pdf", combined_plot, width = 10, height = 2.5 * length(plots_list))

#  Chicken Cluster Annotation and Reordering

# ==============================================================================
# SCRIPT 4M: STAGE-BY-STAGE DIFFERENTIAL EXPRESSION ANALYSIS
# ==============================================================================

#  Load Updated Seurat Objects
# We use the re-annotated and re-ordered objects from SCRIPT 4E 
# to perform pairwise comparisons across the maturation timelines.
chicken <- readRDS("./Processed_Objects/BMscRNA_PBscRNA.rds")
human <- readRDS("./Processed_Objects/HscRNA.rds")

# Chicken Pairwise Comparisons (Avian Maturation)
# Identify genes regulating the transition between nucleated stages.
chicken_diff_exp1 <- FindMarkers(chicken, ident.1 = "Mature erythrocyte-C", ident.2 = "Immature erythrocyte")
chicken_diff_exp2 <- FindMarkers(chicken, ident.1 = "Immature erythrocyte", ident.2 = "Late polychromatic blast")
chicken_diff_exp3 <- FindMarkers(chicken, ident.1 = "Late polychromatic blast", ident.2 = "Mid polychromatic blast")
chicken_diff_exp4 <- FindMarkers(chicken, ident.1 = "Mid polychromatic blast", ident.2 = "Early polychromatic blast")
chicken_diff_exp5 <- FindMarkers(chicken, ident.1 = "Early polychromatic blast", ident.2 = "Late erythroblast")
chicken_diff_exp6 <- FindMarkers(chicken, ident.1 = "Late erythroblast", ident.2 = "Early erythroblast")
chicken_diff_exp7 <- FindMarkers(chicken, ident.1 = "Early erythroblast", ident.2 = "Erythroid progenitor 2")
chicken_diff_exp8 <- FindMarkers(chicken, ident.1 = "Erythroid progenitor 2", ident.2 = "Erythroid progenitor 1")

# Human Pairwise Comparisons (Mammalian Maturation)
# Identify genes regulating mammalian erythroid progression and enucleation.
human_diff_exp1 <- FindMarkers(human, ident.1 = "Mature erythrocyte-H", ident.2 = "Reticulocyte")
human_diff_exp2 <- FindMarkers(human, ident.1 = "Reticulocyte", ident.2 = "Orthochromatic Erythroblast")
human_diff_exp3 <- FindMarkers(human, ident.1 = "Orthochromatic Erythroblast", ident.2 = "Polychromatic Erythroblast")
human_diff_exp4 <- FindMarkers(human, ident.1 = "Polychromatic Erythroblast", ident.2 = "Basophilic Erythroblast")
human_diff_exp5 <- FindMarkers(human, ident.1 = "Basophilic Erythroblast", ident.2 = "Proerythroblast")
human_diff_exp6 <- FindMarkers(human, ident.1 = "Proerythroblast", ident.2 = "CFU-E")
human_diff_exp7 <- FindMarkers(human, ident.1 = "CFU-E", ident.2 = "BFU-E")
human_diff_exp8 <- FindMarkers(human, ident.1 = "BFU-E", ident.2 = "MEP")

# Post-processing and Excel Export
# We consolidate these findings into multi-sheet Excel workbooks, ensuring gene symbols are explicitly included as a column for readability.
# Add Gene column from row names for chicken results
chicken_results_with_genes <- lapply(list(
  "Mature vs Immature" = chicken_diff_exp1,
  "Immature vs Late poly" = chicken_diff_exp2,
  "Late poly vs Mid poly" = chicken_diff_exp3,
  "Mid poly vs Early poly" = chicken_diff_exp4,
  "Early poly vs Late erythro" = chicken_diff_exp5,
  "Late erythro vs Early erythro" = chicken_diff_exp6,
  "Early eryth vs Erythroid prog 2" = chicken_diff_exp7,
  "Erythroid prog 2 vs 1" = chicken_diff_exp8
), function(df) {
  df$Gene <- rownames(df)  # Add Gene column with row names
  return(df)
})
# Save differential expression results to Excel for chicken
write.xlsx(chicken_results_with_genes, file = paste0("./Results/Supplementary_Data-8.xlsx"), overwrite = TRUE)
# Add Gene column from row names for human results
human_results_with_genes <- lapply(list(
  "Mature vs Reticulocyte" = human_diff_exp1,
  "Reticulocyte vs Orthrochromatic" = human_diff_exp2,
  "Orthrochromatic vs Poly" = human_diff_exp3,
  "Poly vs Basophilic" = human_diff_exp4,
  "Basophilic vs Proerythroblast" = human_diff_exp5,
  "Proerythroblast vs CFU-E" = human_diff_exp6,
  "CFU-E vs BFU-E" = human_diff_exp7,
  "BFU-E vs MEP" = human_diff_exp8
), function(df) {
  df$Gene <- rownames(df)  # Add Gene column with row names
  return(df)
})
# Save differential expression results to Excel for human
write.xlsx(human_results_with_genes, file = paste0("./Results/Supplementary_Data-9.xlsx"), overwrite = TRUE)


# ==============================================================================
# SCRIPT 4N: HUMAN METABOLIC PROFILING (scMetabolism)
# ==============================================================================

# Metabolic Dataset Preparation
# We analyze the metabolic landscape of human erythropoiesis to understand the energetic requirements of enucleation and terminal maturation.

HscRNA <- readRDS("./Processed_Objects/HscRNA.rds")
DefaultAssay(HscRNA) <- "RNA" 
Idents(HscRNA) <- "seurat_clusters"
HscRNA_Mb <- HscRNA

#  scMetabolism Analysis Workflow
countexp.Seurat <- sc.metabolism.Seurat(obj = HscRNA_Mb, method = "AUCell", imputation = F, ncores = 6, metabolism.type = "KEGG")
metabolic.matrix <- as.data.frame(countexp.Seurat@assays$METABOLISM$score)
print(paste("Metabolic pathways found:", nrow(metabolic.matrix)))

#  Visualization Adjustment
umap_embeddings <- Embeddings(countexp.Seurat, "umap")  
colnames(umap_embeddings) <- c("UMAP_1", "UMAP_2")      
countexp.Seurat@reductions$umap@cell.embeddings <- umap_embeddings

#  Metabolic Pathway Activity (DotPlot)
pat <- c(
  "Sulfur metabolism", "Starch and sucrose metabolism", "Sphingolipid metabolism",
  "Pyrimidine metabolism", "Purine metabolism", "Propanoate metabolism",
  "Porphyrin and chlorophyll metabolism", "Oxidative phosphorylation",
  "One carbon pool by folate", "Nitrogen metabolism",
  "Glyoxylate and dicarboxylate metabolism", "Glycolysis / Gluconeogenesis",
  "Glutathione metabolism", "Galactose metabolism", "Arginine and proline metabolism"
)

cluster_names <- c(
  "5" = "MEP", "1" = "BFU-E", "2" = "CFU-E", "8" = "Proerythroblast",
  "6" = "Basophilic Erythroblast", "0" = "Polychromatic Erythroblast",
  "4" = "Orthochromatic Erythroblast", "9" = "Reticulocyte", "10" = "Mature erythrocyte"
)

pdf("./Results/S.Fig_5C.pdf", width = 10, height = 5)
DotPlot.metabolism(obj = countexp.Seurat, pathway = pat, phenotype = "seurat_clusters", norm = "y") + 
    scale_x_discrete(limits = names(cluster_names), labels = cluster_names)
dev.off()

h_metab_matrix <- as.data.frame(t(countexp.Seurat@assays$METABOLISM$score))
h_metab_matrix$Stage <- countexp.Seurat$seurat_clusters

# Map Numeric Cluster IDs to Biological Names
h_metab_matrix$StageName <- plyr::revalue(as.character(h_metab_matrix$Stage), cluster_names)

# Filter and Summarize for OXPHOS and Glycolysis
h_plot_data <- h_metab_matrix %>%
  dplyr::select(`Oxidative phosphorylation`, `Glycolysis / Gluconeogenesis`, StageName) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = -StageName, names_to = "Pathway", values_to = "Score") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(StageName, Pathway) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(Mean_Score = mean(Score), .groups = 'drop')

# Set Human Biological Maturation Order
human_maturation_order <- c(
  "MEP", "BFU-E", "CFU-E", "Proerythroblast", 
  "Basophilic Erythroblast", "Polychromatic Erythroblast", 
  "Orthochromatic Erythroblast", "Reticulocyte", "Mature erythrocyte"
)
h_plot_data$StageName <- factor(h_plot_data$StageName, levels = human_maturation_order)

# Generate and Save the Human Trend Plot 
p_human_metab_trend <- ggplot(h_plot_data,  
                              aes(x = StageName,  
                                  y = Mean_Score,  
                                  color = Pathway,  
                                  group = Pathway)) + 
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) + 
  geom_point(size = 3) + 
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) + 
  theme( 
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, color = "black"), 
    legend.position = "top" 
  ) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c( 
    "Oxidative phosphorylation" = "#D95F02",  
    "Glycolysis / Gluconeogenesis" = "#1B9E77" 
  )) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = rev(levels(h_plot_data$StageName))) +
  labs( 
    title = "Human Metabolic Adaptation",  
    subtitle = "ATP-intensive remodeling trajectory", 
    y = "AUCell Score (Mean)",  
    x = "Maturation Stage" 
  ) 
 
ggsave( 
  "./Results/Fig_3F.pdf",  
  p_human_metab_trend,  
  width = 4,  
  height = 4 
)

library(Seurat)
