```{r}
# ---- 1. Load data ------------------------------------------------------------
chicken <- readRDS("./Processed_Objects/BMscRNA_PBscRNA.rds")
human   <- readRDS("./Processed_Objects/HscRNA.rds")

DefaultAssay(chicken) <- "integrated"
DefaultAssay(human)   <- "RNA"

# ---- 2. Stage annotation (early -> late, left to right on the x-axis) --------
order_chicken <- c(
  "Erythroid progenitor 1", "Erythroid progenitor 2", "Early erythroblast",
  "Late erythroblast", "Early polychromatic blast", "Mid polychromatic blast",
  "Late polychromatic blast", "Immature erythrocyte", "Mature erythrocyte-C"
)
chicken$cell_type <- plyr::mapvalues(
  x    = chicken$seurat_clusters,
  from = c(5, 3, 8, 2, 4, 1, 0, 6, 9),
  to   = order_chicken
)
Idents(chicken) <- factor(chicken$cell_type, levels = order_chicken)

clusters_human <- c(
  "5" = "MEP", "1" = "BFU-E", "2" = "CFU-E", "8" = "Proerythroblast",
  "6" = "Basophilic Erythroblast", "0" = "Polychromatic Erythroblast",
  "4" = "Orthochromatic Erythroblast", "9" = "Reticulocyte",
  "10" = "Mature erythrocyte-H"
)
order_human <- unname(clusters_human[c("5", "1", "2", "8", "6", "0", "4", "9", "10")])
human$cell_type <- plyr::mapvalues(
  human$seurat_clusters,
  from = names(clusters_human),
  to   = clusters_human
)
Idents(human) <- factor(human$cell_type, levels = order_human)

# ---- 3. Check that VIM exists in both objects --------------------------------
gene <- "VIM"
for (obj_name in c("chicken", "human")) {
  if (!gene %in% rownames(get(obj_name))) {
    stop(gene, " not found in ", obj_name, " object. Check the gene symbol.")
  }
}

# ---- 4. Violin plot function (one gene, one species) -------------------------
plot_vim <- function(object, title, fill_col) {
  p <- VlnPlot(object, features = gene, pt.size = 0, cols = rep(fill_col, length(levels(Idents(object))))) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, fill = "white", outlier.shape = NA, color = "black")

  n_labels <- paste0("n=", as.integer(table(Idents(object))))
  max_y <- max(FetchData(object, vars = gene), na.rm = TRUE) * 1.1

  p +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.2))) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    annotate("text", x = seq_along(n_labels), y = max_y, label = n_labels,
             size = 3, angle = 45, vjust = 0.5, fontface = "bold") +
    labs(title = title, y = "VIM expression (log-normalized)") +
    theme(
      axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 9),
      plot.title   = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10, face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
}

p_chicken <- plot_vim(chicken, "Chicken: VIM", "#E69F00")
p_human   <- plot_vim(human,   "Human: VIM",   "#009E73")

# ---- 5. Save the figure ------------------------------------------------------
dir.create("./Results", showWarnings = FALSE)
pdf("./Results/S.Figure_6b.pdf", width = 10, height = 4)
print(p_chicken | p_human)
dev.off()

# ---- 6. Export numbers behind the plot (percent expressing and mean) ---------
summarise_vim <- function(object, species) {
  expr <- FetchData(object, vars = gene)[, 1]
  df <- data.frame(stage = as.character(Idents(object)), expr = expr)
  out <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(df, df$stage), function(d) {
    data.frame(
      species      = species,
      stage        = d$stage[1],
      n_cells      = nrow(d),
      pct_expr     = round(100 * mean(d$expr > 0), 1),
      mean_expr    = round(mean(d$expr), 3),
      median_expr  = round(median(d$expr), 3)
    )
  }))
  out[match(levels(Idents(object)), out$stage), ]
}

vim_summary <- rbind(
  summarise_vim(chicken, "Chicken"),
  summarise_vim(human,   "Human")
)
write.xlsx(vim_summary, "./Results/Supplementary Data 13.xlsx", rowNames = FALSE)
print(vim_summary)

if ("Assay5" %in% class(human[["RNA"]])) {

  count_layers <- grep(
    "^counts\\.",
    Layers(human[["RNA"]]),
    value = TRUE
  )

  if (length(count_layers) > 1) {

    cat("Multiple Seurat v5 count layers detected.\n")
    cat("Merging count layers before Monocle 3 conversion...\n")

    list_of_counts <- lapply(
      count_layers,
      function(layer) {
        LayerData(
          human,
          assay = "RNA",
          layer = layer
        )
      }
    )

    merged_counts <- SeuratObject:::RowMergeSparseMatrices(
      list_of_counts[[1]],
      list_of_counts[2:length(list_of_counts)]
    )

    # Preserve metadata
    human_sanitized <- CreateSeuratObject(
      counts = merged_counts,
      meta.data = human@meta.data
    )

    # Recalculate basic dimensional reduction
    human_sanitized <- NormalizeData(
      human_sanitized,
      normalization.method = "LogNormalize",
      scale.factor = 10000
    )

    human_sanitized <- FindVariableFeatures(
      human_sanitized,
      selection.method = "vst",
      nfeatures = 2000
    )

    human_sanitized <- ScaleData(human_sanitized)

    human_sanitized <- RunPCA(
      human_sanitized,
      npcs = 30
    )

    set.seed(1234)

    human_sanitized <- RunUMAP(
      human_sanitized,
      dims = 1:20
    )

    # Restore developmental identity
    human_sanitized$cell_type <- factor(
      human$cell_type[colnames(human_sanitized)],
      levels = custom_order_human
    )

    Idents(human_sanitized) <- human_sanitized$cell_type

    human <- human_sanitized
  }
}

# Convert to Monocle 3
human_cds <- as.cell_data_set(human)

# Make sure cell type information is available
colData(human_cds)$cell_type <- human$cell_type


cat("\n--- Constructing human developmental trajectory ---\n")

set.seed(1234)

human_cds <- cluster_cells(
  human_cds,
  reduction_method = "UMAP"
)

set.seed(1234)

human_cds <- learn_graph(
  human_cds,
  use_partition = FALSE
)

cat("Trajectory graph successfully learned.\n")


cat("\n--- Rooting trajectory at MEP ---\n")

root_cells <- colnames(human_cds)[
  colData(human_cds)$cell_type == "MEP"
]

if (length(root_cells) == 0) {
  stop("ERROR: No MEP cells were found for trajectory rooting.")
}

cat("Number of MEP root cells:", length(root_cells), "\n")

human_cds <- order_cells(
  human_cds,
  root_cells = root_cells
)

cat("Human pseudotime successfully calculated.\n")


human_pseudotime <- pseudotime(human_cds)

pseudotime_df <- data.frame(
  cell = names(human_pseudotime),
  pseudotime = as.numeric(human_pseudotime),
  cell_type = colData(human_cds)$cell_type
)

# Remove cells with undefined pseudotime
pseudotime_df <- pseudotime_df %>%
  filter(is.finite(pseudotime))

# Order clusters developmentally
pseudotime_df$cell_type <- factor(
  pseudotime_df$cell_type,
  levels = custom_order_human
)


cat("\n--- Generating human developmental pseudotime plot ---\n")

p_human <- plot_cells(
  human_cds,
  color_cells_by = "pseudotime",
  show_trajectory_graph = TRUE,

  # Do not label individual cells
  label_cell_groups = FALSE,
  label_leaves = FALSE,
  label_branch_points = FALSE,

  # UMAP appearance
  cell_size = 0.7,
  graph_label_size = 0,

  # No cluster labels on the plot
  group_label_size = 0
) +
  labs(
    title = "Human Erythroid Developmental Trajectory",
    x = "UMAP 1",
    y = "UMAP 2",
    color = "Pseudotime"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

print(p_human)


ggsave(
  filename = output_pdf_path,
  plot = p_human,
  width = 8,
  height = 7,
  units = "in",
  device = "pdf"
)

cat("\nHuman pseudotime plot saved to:\n")
cat(output_pdf_path, "\n")


write.xlsx(
  pseudotime_df,
  file = output_xlsx_path,
  rowNames = FALSE
)

cat("\nPseudotime data saved to:\n")
cat(output_xlsx_path, "\n")

summary_df <- pseudotime_df %>%
  group_by(cell_type) %>%
  summarise(
    n_cells = n(),
    median_pseudotime = median(pseudotime),
    mean_pseudotime = mean(pseudotime),
    min_pseudotime = min(pseudotime),
    max_pseudotime = max(pseudotime),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("\n--- Human developmental pseudotime summary ---\n")
print(summary_df)


# ==============================================================================
# SCRIPT 4Q: HUMAN HEMATOPOIETIC NICHE SIGNALING
# ==============================================================================

#  Project Setup and Path Configuration
# We utilize the full Bandyopadhyay atlas to extract myeloid "support" 
# cells and the focused HscRNA object for the erythroid "target" cells.

# Define Input Paths
full_human_data_path <- "./Raw_Data/Public_Reference_Data/Human_Atlas_HscRNA/GSE253355.rds"
erythroid_only_path  <- "./Processed_Objects/HscRNA.rds"

# Define Output Paths
final_plots_pdf     <- file.path("./Results/S.Fig_5D-E.pdf")
final_results_excel <- file.path("./Results/Supplementary_Data-16.xlsx")

cat("Setup complete. Paths are set for the final focused analysis.\n")


#  Prepare the Focused Niche Object
# Create a unified Seurat object containing myeloid niche cells and the early stages of the erythroid maturation trajectory.
cat("\n--- Part 1: Preparing a focused Myeloid + Erythroid object ---\n")
full_b_marrow <- readRDS(full_human_data_path)
myeloid_names <- c("Macrophages", "Monocyte", "Late Myeloid", "Early Myeloid Progenitor", "GMP") 
myeloid_cells <- subset(full_b_marrow, subset = cluster_anno_l2 %in% myeloid_names)
myeloid_cells$cell_type_final <- "Myeloid"
rm(full_b_marrow); gc()
erythroid_lineage <- readRDS(erythroid_only_path)
new_cluster_names_human <- c("5"="MEP", "1"="BFU-E", "2"="CFU-E")
erythroid_lineage$cell_type_final <- plyr::mapvalues(
  erythroid_lineage$seurat_clusters, 
  from = names(new_cluster_names_human), 
  to = new_cluster_names_human,
  warn_missing = FALSE
)
early_erythroid_cells <- subset(erythroid_lineage, subset = cell_type_final %in% c("MEP", "BFU-E", "CFU-E"))
DefaultAssay(myeloid_cells) <- "RNA"; DefaultAssay(early_erythroid_cells) <- "RNA"
myeloid_cells <- NormalizeData(myeloid_cells); early_erythroid_cells <- NormalizeData(early_erythroid_cells)
merged_obj <- merge(myeloid_cells, y = early_erythroid_cells)

#  Run CellChat Analysis Workflow
# Identify over-expressed ligands and receptors and calculate communication probabilities between the niche and progenitors.
cat("\n--- Part 2: Running CellChat on the focused dataset ---\n")
data.input <- GetAssayData(merged_obj, assay = "RNA", layer = "data") 
meta <- merged_obj@meta.data
cell_group_order <- c("Myeloid", "MEP", "BFU-E", "CFU-E")
meta$cell_chat_group <- factor(meta$cell_type_final, levels = cell_group_order)
cellchat <- createCellChat(object = data.input, meta = meta, group.by = "cell_chat_group")
CellChatDB <- CellChatDB.human
cellchat@DB <- subsetDB(CellChatDB, search = "Secreted Signaling") 
cellchat <- subsetData(cellchat)
cellchat <- identifyOverExpressedGenes(cellchat)
cellchat <- identifyOverExpressedInteractions(cellchat)
cellchat <- computeCommunProb(cellchat)
cellchat <- filterCommunication(cellchat, min.cells = 10)
cellchat <- computeCommunProbPathway(cellchat)
cellchat <- aggregateNet(cellchat)
cat("CellChat analysis complete.\n")

# Niche Visualization . Visualize the overall interaction strength and specific 
# ligand-receptor pairs bridging myeloid cells and erythroid progenitors.
cat("\n--- Part 3: Visualizing results and exporting to Excel ---\n")
pdf(final_plots_pdf, width = 5, height = 4, onefile = TRUE)
all_interactions_df <- subsetCommunication(cellchat)
pval_threshold <- 0.01
significant_interactions_df <- all_interactions_df %>%
  filter(pval < pval_threshold)
cat(paste("Found", nrow(significant_interactions_df), "interactions with p-value <", pval_threshold, "\n"))
netVisual_circle(cellchat@net$weight, vertex.weight = as.numeric(table(cellchat@meta$cell_chat_group)), 
                 weight.scale = T, label.edge = F, title.name = "Interaction Strength - Myeloid to Early Progenitors")

# Ligand-Receptor Bubble Plot
# To identify specific signaling axes targeting early progenitors.
p_bubble <- netVisual_bubble(cellchat, sources.use = "Myeloid", remove.isolate = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "Specific Ligand-Receptor Pairs from Myeloid Cells")
print(p_bubble)
dev.off() 

#  Data Export
# Export strictly filtered significant interactions for final manuscript documentation.
cat("Exporting key data to Excel...\n")
pathway_summary_filtered_df <- significant_interactions_df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(pathway_name, source, target) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(total_interaction_strength = sum(prob), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(total_interaction_strength))
avg_expression_df <- as.data.frame(cellchat@data.signaling)
list_of_datasets_to_export <- list(
  "Significant_Interactions_p0.01" = significant_interactions_df,
  "Ranked_Pathways_p0.01"          = pathway_summary_filtered_df,
  "All_Interactions_Found"         = all_interactions_df, 
  "Avg_Gene_Expression"            = tibble::rownames_to_column(avg_expression_df, "gene")
)
write.xlsx(list_of_datasets_to_export, file = final_results_excel, rowNames = FALSE)
cat("\n\n--- FINAL FOCUSED ANALYSIS COMPLETE ---\n")


# ==============================================================================
# SCRIPT 4R: Characterization of the Avian Immuno-Erythroid Niche Axis and the Ontogeny of Erythroid Immunity
# ==============================================================================


#  Load Bone Marrow Data & Marker Discovery
# To identify the baseline transcriptomic signatures of all 16 bone marrow 
# populations before modeling niche-specific signaling.
load("./Processed_Objects/BMscRNA_Processed.Rdata")
BMscRNA <- PrepSCTFindMarkers(BMscRNA, assay = "SCT", verbose = TRUE)
BMscRNA.markers <- FindAllMarkers(BMscRNA,
  only.pos = TRUE, 
  min.pct = 0.25,
  logfc.threshold = 0.25)

#  Niche Annotation & Order Standardization
# We define the full bone marrow niche, including lymphoid and myeloid 
# support cells, to identify global signaling hubs.
DefaultAssay(BMscRNA) <- "RNA"
cluster2type <- c(
  "0" = "Late polychromatic blast",
  "1" = "Early polychromatic blast",
  "2" = "Late erythroblast",
  "3" = "Erythroid progenitor 1",
  "4" = "Mid polychromatic blast",
  "5" = "Erythroid progenitor 2",
  "6" = "Early erythroblast",
  "7" = "Hematopoietic stem cells",
  "8" = "Immature erythrocyte",
  "9" = "Thrombocyte precursor",
  "10" = "T cells",
  "11" = "Eosinophil",
  "12" = "Common myeloid progenitors",
  "13" = "B cells",
  "14" = "Mesenchymal stem cells",
  "15" = "Proliferating cells"
)
BMscRNA[['cell_type']] = unname(cluster2type[BMscRNA@meta.data$seurat_clusters])
cluster_order <- c(
  "Immature erythrocyte", "Late polychromatic blast", "Mid polychromatic blast", 
  "Early polychromatic blast", "Late erythroblast", "Early erythroblast", 
  "Erythroid progenitor 2", "Erythroid progenitor 1", "Proliferating cells", 
  "Mesenchymal stem cells", "Hematopoietic stem cells", "T cells", 
  "Common myeloid progenitors", "Thrombocyte precursor", "Eosinophil", "B cells"
)
BMscRNA@meta.data$cell_type <- factor(BMscRNA@meta.data$cell_type, levels = cluster_order)
set.seed(111)
cluster_colors <- c(
  "#6B92B9", "#D48A9C", "#6F9CBE", "#9CAF74", "#C1B06D", 
  "#B5B500", "#BAB77C", "#D7868E", "#D46969", "#6BA0A7", 
  "#6BAFAD", "#A6A6A6", "#BF6E6E", "#A982B2", 
  "#88A1A8", "#A45757"
)

#  CellChat Object Construction: Global Niche
# We utilize the human signaling database to infer 1-to-1 orthologous 
# communication patterns in the chicken bone marrow.
data.input <- GetAssayData(BMscRNA, assay = "RNA", slot = "data")
labels <- BMscRNA$cell_type
meta <- data.frame(labels = labels, row.names = names(labels))
cellchat <- createCellChat(object = data.input, meta = meta, group.by = "labels")
CellChatDB <- CellChatDB.human 
cellchat@DB <- CellChatDB

#  Communication Probability Inference
# Using the truncatedMean method (trim=0.1) as specified in the Methods 
# to calculate stable signaling probabilities.
cellchat <- subsetData(cellchat) 
cellchat <- identifyOverExpressedGenes(cellchat)
cellchat <- identifyOverExpressedInteractions(cellchat)
cellchat <- computeCommunProb(cellchat, type = "truncatedMean", trim = 0.1, population.size = FALSE)
cellchat <- filterCommunication(cellchat, min.cells = 5)
cellchat <- computeCommunProbPathway(cellchat)
cellchat <- aggregateNet(cellchat)

#  Signaling Role & Centrality Analysis
# To identify which populations serve as primary senders or 
# receivers of systemic signals in the niche.
cellchat <- netAnalysis_computeCentrality(cellchat, slot.name = "netP")
nPathway <- length(cellchat@netP$pathways)
groupSize <- as.numeric(table(cellchat@idents))
write.csv(as.data.frame(cellchat@net$weight), 
          file = "./Results/Supplementary_Data-19.csv", 
          row.names = TRUE)
pathways <- cellchat@netP$pathways
cell_groups <- levels(cellchat@idents)
df_outgoing <- matrix(0, nrow = length(pathways), ncol = length(cell_groups), 
                      dimnames = list(pathways, cell_groups))
for (p in pathways) {
  df_outgoing[p, ] <- cellchat@netP$centr[[p]]$outdeg
}
df_incoming <- matrix(0, nrow = length(pathways), ncol = length(cell_groups), 
                      dimnames = list(pathways, cell_groups))
for (p in pathways) {
  df_incoming[p, ] <- cellchat@netP$centr[[p]]$indeg
}

wb_roles <- createWorkbook()
addWorksheet(wb_roles, "Outgoing_Signaling")
writeData(wb_roles, "Outgoing_Signaling", as.data.frame(df_outgoing), rowNames = TRUE)

addWorksheet(wb_roles, "Incoming_Signaling")
writeData(wb_roles, "Incoming_Signaling", as.data.frame(df_incoming), rowNames = TRUE)

saveWorkbook(wb_roles,
             file = "./Results/Supplementary_Data-21.xlsx",
             overwrite = TRUE)

# Global Signaling Heatmaps 
pdf("./Results/S.Fig_10B.pdf", width = 10, height = 8)
p1 <- netAnalysis_signalingRole_heatmap(
  cellchat, 
  pattern = "outgoing", 
  font.size = 8,               
  font.size.title = 10,
  height = unit(nPathway * 0.35, "cm") 
)
p2 <- netAnalysis_signalingRole_heatmap(
  cellchat, 
  pattern = "incoming", 
  font.size = 8, 
  font.size.title = 10,
  height = unit(nPathway * 0.35, "cm")
)
ComplexHeatmap::draw(p1 + p2, ht_gap = unit(1, "cm"))
dev.off()

#  Global Network Visualization 
pdf("./Results/S.Fig_10A.pdf", width = 7, height = 4)
par(mar = c(1, 1, 1, 1)) 
netVisual_circle(
  cellchat@net$weight,
  vertex.weight = groupSize * 0.7,   
  weight.scale = TRUE,
  label.edge = FALSE,
  vertex.label.cex = 0.8,            
  edge.width.max = 5,               
  title.name = "Global Interaction Strength: BM Niche",
  arrow.size = 0.1,
  margin = 0.2                      
)
dev.off()

#  Immuno-Erythroid Axis Subset Analysis
clusters_of_interest <- c(
  "Erythroid progenitor 1",
  "Erythroid progenitor 2",
  "T cells",
  "B cells"
)
BMscRNA_subset <- subset(BMscRNA, subset = cell_type %in% clusters_of_interest)
DefaultAssay(BMscRNA_subset) <- "RNA"
data.input <- GetAssayData(BMscRNA_subset, assay = "RNA", slot = "data")
labels <- BMscRNA_subset$cell_type
meta <- data.frame(cell_type = labels, row.names = names(labels))
cellchat_subset <- createCellChat(object = data.input, meta = meta, group.by = "cell_type")
cellchat_subset@DB <- CellChatDB.human  
cellchat_subset <- subsetData(cellchat_subset)
cellchat_subset <- identifyOverExpressedGenes(cellchat_subset)
cellchat_subset <- identifyOverExpressedInteractions(cellchat_subset)
cellchat_subset <- computeCommunProb(cellchat_subset, type = "truncatedMean", trim = 0.1, population.size = FALSE)
cellchat_subset <- filterCommunication(cellchat_subset, min.cells = 5)
cellchat_subset <- computeCommunProbPathway(cellchat_subset)
cellchat_subset <- aggregateNet(cellchat_subset)
cellchat_subset <- netAnalysis_computeCentrality(cellchat_subset, slot.name = "netP")

#  Visualizing Lymphoid-to-Erythroid Signals 
nPathway <- length(cellchat_subset@netP$pathways)
pdf("./Results/Fig_7A.pdf", width = 12, height = 6)
p_out <- netAnalysis_signalingRole_heatmap(cellchat_subset, pattern = "outgoing",
                                           font.size = 11, height = unit(nPathway * 0.7, "cm"))
p_in <- netAnalysis_signalingRole_heatmap(cellchat_subset, pattern = "incoming",
                                          font.size = 11, height = unit(nPathway * 0.7, "cm"))
ComplexHeatmap::draw(p_out + p_in, ht_gap = unit(2.5, "cm"))
dev.off()

#  Top Signaling Pathways & Focused Immune Axis 
groupSize <- as.numeric(table(cellchat_subset@idents))
pdf("./Results/Result_Supporting_Files/Subset_Erythroid_Immune_Cells.pdf", width = 12, height = 18)
netVisual_circle(cellchat_subset@net$weight,
                 vertex.weight = groupSize,
                 weight.scale = TRUE,
                 label.edge = FALSE,
                 vertex.label.cex = 1.3,
                 edge.width.max = 12,
                 title.name = "Subset Interaction Strength: Erythroid + T/B")
dev.off()

pathway_weights <- sapply(cellchat_subset@netP$pathways, function(pathway) {
  sum(cellchat_subset@netP[[pathway]]$prob)
})
top25_pathways <- names(sort(pathway_weights, decreasing = TRUE))[1:min(25, length(pathway_weights))]
p_top25 <- netVisual_bubble(cellchat_subset,
                            sources.use = clusters_of_interest,
                            targets.use = clusters_of_interest,
                            signaling = top25_pathways,
                            remove.isolate = TRUE,
                            font.size = 8)
p_top25_final <- p_top25 + 
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 8)) + 
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 7),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
    plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5)
  )

pdf("./Results/S.Fig_10C.pdf", width = 7, height = 5)
print(p_top25_final)
dev.off()

focused_pathways <- c("IFN-II", "BAFF", "MIF", "APP")

p_foc <- netVisual_bubble(cellchat_subset, 
                          sources.use = clusters_of_interest, 
                          targets.use = clusters_of_interest, 
                          signaling = focused_pathways, 
                          remove.isolate = TRUE,
                          font.size = 9) 

p_foc_final <- p_foc + 
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(6, 13)) + 
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 9, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
    plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.5, "cm")
  )

pdf("./Results/Fig_7B.pdf", width = 6, height = 4)
print(p_foc_final)
dev.off()

#  Exporting Signaling Data
df_focused <- subsetCommunication(cellchat_subset, signaling = focused_pathways,
                                  sources.use = clusters_of_interest, targets.use = clusters_of_interest)
df_top25 <- subsetCommunication(cellchat_subset, signaling = top25_pathways,
                                sources.use = clusters_of_interest, targets.use = clusters_of_interest)
wb <- createWorkbook()
addWorksheet(wb, "Focused_Signaling")
writeData(wb, "Focused_Signaling", df_focused[order(df_focused$prob, decreasing = TRUE), ])

addWorksheet(wb, "Top25_Signaling")
writeData(wb, "Top25_Signaling", df_top25[order(df_top25$prob, decreasing = TRUE), ])

saveWorkbook(wb,
             file = "./Results/Supplementary_Data-22.xlsx",
             overwrite = TRUE)

#  Trajectory Validation: JAK-STAT Pathway Ontogeny
BMscRNA_PBscRNA <- readRDS("./Processed_Objects/BMscRNA_PBscRNA.rds")
new_cluster_names <- c(
  "0" = "Late polychromatic blast", 
  "1" = "Mid polychromatic blast",
  "2" = "Late erythroblast", 
  "3" = "Erythroid progenitor 2",
  "4" = "Early polychromatic blast", 
  "5" = "Erythroid progenitor 1",
  "6" = "Immature erythrocyte", 
  "8" = "Early erythroblast",
  "9" = "Mature erythrocyte"
)
Idents(BMscRNA_PBscRNA) <- "seurat_clusters"
BMscRNA_PBscRNA <- RenameIdents(BMscRNA_PBscRNA, new_cluster_names)

new_order <- c(
  "Mature erythrocyte", "Immature erythrocyte", "Late polychromatic blast", 
  "Mid polychromatic blast", "Early polychromatic blast", "Late erythroblast", 
  "Early erythroblast", "Erythroid progenitor 2", "Erythroid progenitor 1"
)
BMscRNA_PBscRNA@active.ident <- factor(Idents(BMscRNA_PBscRNA), levels = rev(new_order))

DefaultAssay(BMscRNA_PBscRNA) <- "RNA"
BMscRNA_PBscRNA <- JoinLayers(BMscRNA_PBscRNA)
BMscRNA_PBscRNA <- NormalizeData(BMscRNA_PBscRNA)

#  Immune Gene Expression Mapping 
genes_to_plot <- c("IFNAR1", "JAK1", "JAK2", "MX1", "SOCS1", "SOCS2", "STAT1")

) +

    axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.title = element_blank(),    
    plot.subtitle = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Genes",
    y = "Developmental Stage",
    color = "Average\nExpression",
    size = "Percent\nExpressed"
  )
ggsave("./Results/Fig_7C.pdf", 
       plot = dot_plot,

       height = 5,
```

```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# SCRIPT 4S: HUMAN VS CHICKEN DEVELOPMENTAL MARKER DOT PLOTS (Supp. Fig. 5A)
# ==============================================================================
# PURPOSE:
#   Same surface/developmental markers, same layout, across erythroid maturation
#   in human and chicken. Genes with no annotated chicken counterpart are
#   reported in the caption, not plotted as zeros.
# INPUT:  ./Processed_Objects/HscRNA.rds, BMscRNA_PBscRNA.rds
# OUTPUT: ./Results/S.Fig_5A_human_vs_chicken.pdf
# ==============================================================================

setwd("./Avian-Erythroid-Atlas")
library(Seurat); library(ggplot2); library(patchwork)

human   <- readRDS("./Processed_Objects/HscRNA.rds")
chicken <- readRDS("./Processed_Objects/BMscRNA_PBscRNA.rds")

human_names <- c("5" = "MEP", "1" = "BFU-E", "2" = "CFU-E", "8" = "Proerythroblast",
                 "6" = "Basophilic Erythroblast", "0" = "Polychromatic Erythroblast",
                 "4" = "Orthochromatic Erythroblast", "9" = "Reticulocyte",
                 "10" = "Mature erythrocyte-H")
chicken_names <- c("5" = "Erythroid progenitor 1", "3" = "Erythroid progenitor 2",
                   "8" = "Early erythroblast", "2" = "Late erythroblast",
                   "4" = "Early polychromatic blast", "1" = "Mid polychromatic blast",
                   "0" = "Late polychromatic blast", "6" = "Immature erythrocyte",
                   "9" = "Mature erythrocyte-C")

human_order <- c("MEP", "BFU-E", "CFU-E", "Proerythroblast", "Basophilic Erythroblast",
                 "Polychromatic Erythroblast", "Orthochromatic Erythroblast",
                 "Reticulocyte", "Mature erythrocyte-H")
chicken_order <- c("Erythroid progenitor 1", "Erythroid progenitor 2", "Early erythroblast",
                   "Early polychromatic blast", "Mid polychromatic blast",
                   "Late polychromatic blast", "Late erythroblast",
                   "Immature erythrocyte", "Mature erythrocyte-C")

prep_obj <- function(x, name_map, stage_levels) {
  st <- unname(name_map[as.character(x$seurat_clusters)])
  x$stage <- st
  x <- subset(x, cells = colnames(x)[!is.na(x$stage)])
  x$stage <- factor(x$stage, levels = stage_levels)
  stopifnot(!any(is.na(x$stage)))
  DefaultAssay(x) <- "RNA"
  x <- tryCatch(JoinLayers(x), error = function(e) x)
  if (!("data" %in% Layers(x[["RNA"]]))) x <- NormalizeData(x)
  x
}
human_obj   <- prep_obj(human,   human_names,   human_order)
chicken_obj <- prep_obj(chicken, chicken_names, chicken_order)

cat("Human cells per stage:\n");   print(table(human_obj$stage))
cat("Chicken cells per stage:\n"); print(table(chicken_obj$stage))


genes_all <- c("CD34", "THY1", "IL3RA", "PTPRC", "CD38", "KIT",
               "ITGA4", "CD36", "TFRC", "ENG", "GYPA", "GYPB")
in_h <- genes_all %in% rownames(human_obj)
in_c <- genes_all %in% rownames(chicken_obj)
cat("Missing in human:  ", genes_all[!in_h], "\n")
cat("Missing in chicken:", genes_all[!in_c], "\n")

genes_both <- genes_all[in_h & in_c]
cat("Plotting", length(genes_both), "genes present in both species:", genes_both, "\n")


theme_dot <- function() {
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
          axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold"),
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))
}

p_h <- DotPlot(human_obj, features = genes_both, group.by = "stage",
               dot.scale = 7, cols = c("lightgrey", "red"), scale.min = 0, scale.max = 100) +
  labs(title = "Human", x = NULL, y = NULL, color = "Average expression",
       size = "Percent expressed") + theme_dot()

p_c <- DotPlot(chicken_obj, features = genes_both, group.by = "stage",
               dot.scale = 7, cols = c("lightgrey", "red"), scale.min = 0, scale.max = 100) +
  labs(title = "Chicken", x = NULL, y = NULL, color = "Average expression",
       size = "Percent expressed") + theme_dot()

combined <- p_h + p_c + plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(
    caption = paste0("No annotated chicken ortholog in this dataset: ",
                     paste(genes_all[!in_c], collapse = ", "),
                     ". Colour scale is set within each panel; compare dot size across species."),
    theme = theme(plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 9)))

ggsave("./Results/S.Fig_5A_human_vs_chicken.pdf", combined, width = 14, height = 4.5)
cat("--- DONE: S.Fig_5A_human_vs_chicken.pdf ---\n")


```
